text: 사람들 떠들어도 별로 시끄럽다고 느껴지지 않고 앞마당은 주차하기 좋고요 발렛비 별도 부과 이제 추워져서 마당 테이블엔 못앉겠어요
text_en: Even though people are talking, it doesn't feel too noisy and the front yard is good for parking. Valet fee is charged separately. It's getting cold now so I can't sit at the table in the yard.

text: 제일 가까운 공차라 자주 이용하는데 화장실에 기본적으로 핸드워시, 휴지, 핸드페이퍼나 핸드드라이는 좀 구비해주세요
text_en: I use it often because it is the closest Gongcha, so please provide some basic hand wash, tissues, hand paper, and hand dryers in the bathroom.

text: 매해 생일마다 플디에서 케이크 구매하고 있는데 항상 너무 맛있습니다!
text_en: I buy a cake from PD every year for my birthday, and it's always so delicious!

text: 프렌치토스트도 맛있구 커피도 오렌셔벗에이드도 다 최고에요
text_en: The French toast is delicious, and the coffee and Oren sherbet ade are all great.

text: 커피로 이렇게 다양하게 즐길 수 있다는 점에서, 그리고 여러 퍼포먼스와 맛을 즐길 수 있다는 점에서 다른 성수 카페, 성수 오마카게 저리가라지 않나 싶네요!
text_en: In that you can enjoy so many different things with coffee, and in that you can enjoy various performances and flavors, I think other Seongsu cafes and Seongsu Omakage should go away!

text: 안그래도 좁은 매장에 손님들 줄서는거 관리 하나 못하는 알바생 환장콤보 멀뚱히 서있는거 보는 제가 다 속터져요
text_en: Even so, I get upset when I see the part-time jobber who can't even manage the line of customers in a small store, just standing there blankly.

text: 사람들도 많이 방문하는 것 같고 분위기도 꽤 좋았어서 기억에 남는 카페인 것 같습니당
text_en: It seems like a lot of people visit and the atmosphere is pretty nice, so it seems like a memorable cafe.

text: 강아지와 산책하는길에 들렸는데 강아지도 입장할수 있어 편하게 주문했고, 인테리어도 좋고 특히 커피가 맛있어서 기분이 좋았습니다
text_en: I stopped by while walking my dog, and dogs were allowed inside, so I ordered comfortably. The interior was nice, and the coffee was especially delicious, so I felt good.

text: 이전에 한번 방문해서 먹었을 때 너무 맛있었어서 20분 정도 줄 서서 받았는데 이번엔 빵이 따뜻하지 않아서 조금 아쉬웠어요
text_en: When I visited once before, it was so delicious that I waited in line for about 20 minutes to get it, but this time I was a little disappointed that the bread wasn't warm.

text: 배불러서 1개만 먹어보고팠는데 ~;; 맛은 겉에가 바삭할줄 알았는데 겉에도 부드러운느낌 ~ 3개는 돌아다니느라 못먹고 가방에 짱박아 놓았네요
text_en: I was so full that I only ate one. I thought it would be crunchy on the outside, but it felt soft on the outside. I couldn't eat 3 of them because I was running around, so I stuffed them in my bag.

text: 매장은 키오스크 결제하고 픽업하는 입구 공간이 다일 정도로 컴팩트 한데, 단일메뉴 그리고 낱개 판매가 아닌 4개 1박스 세트메뉴 구성, 하루 딱 6번 굽고 판매하는 점 등 극한의 매출 효율성을 높인 점이 인상적.
text_en: The store is compact enough to have multiple entrance spaces for kiosk payment and pickup, but it is impressive that it has increased sales efficiency to the extreme by offering a single menu and a set menu of 4 items in a box rather than selling them individually, and by baking and selling only 6 times a day.

text: 매장은 전체적으로 깔끔하고 소금빵이라 그런지 소금이 가마솥에 엄청많이 있는게 신기해서 좋았고 줄도 빨리빨리 줄어들어서 금방구매할수있는점이 좋았어요
text_en: The overall store was clean and it was nice to see that there was a lot of salt in the cauldron, probably because it was salt bread, and the line moved quickly so I was able to purchase it quickly.

text: 우블라떼, 오렌지가 들어간 카푸치노 느낌의 커피라떼인데 달지도않고 오렌지향이 강하거나해서거부감도 없이 은은하고 너무 예쁘게 담겨나와요~
text_en: Oublatte, a cappuccino-like coffee latte with orange, is not too sweet and has a strong orange scent, so you won't be put off, and it's served beautifully and delicately.

text: 👍👍bgm도 잔잔해서 편안하게 멍때리기도 좋고 자주 오고 싶은 곳!
text_en: 👍👍The bgm is calm, so it’s great to just zone out, and it’s a place I want to come often!

text: 재방문하면서 보였던 것들 👀 낙선재의 월문처럼 '육각형'의 한옥미 테이블 바, 창문, 그리고, 서랍장 손잡이로 시선이 고즈넉하면서도 차분한 분위기가 안에서 바깥으로 이번에는 바에서 쑥차를 마셨는데, 향긋함이 한가득 몸이 따뜻해지는 차 한모금에 걱정거리가 녹아내리는 다음에는 오픈한 루프탑에서 시원한 바람과 차온 예정 :)
text_en: Things I saw during my return visit 👀 Like Nakseonjae's Wolmoon, the 'hexagonal' Hanok-style table, bar, windows, and drawer handles create a serene and calm atmosphere from inside to outside. This time, I drank mugwort tea at the bar. My worries melted away with a sip of fragrant tea that warmed my body. Afterwards, I plan to enjoy the cool breeze and chill on the open rooftop :)

text: 방문 전 봤던 다른 리뷰들에서는 직원분이 불친절하다는 말도 많았으나, 제가 방문했을 때는 직원분도 친절하셔서 재방문 의사 완전 있습니다.
text_en: Many of the other reviews I read before visiting said that the staff was unfriendly, but when I visited, the staff was so friendly that I would definitely visit again.

text: 근데 개인적으로 낱개로 1개씩 파는 편이 더 소비자지향적이라 생각하는데 마진이 어떻게 된건지 4개씩 세트만 판매하는 건 살짝 트렌드에 뒤쳐진 것 같다는 생각이 들었어요.
text_en: However, I personally think that selling each item individually is more consumer-oriented, but I thought that selling only sets of 4 seems to be slightly behind the trend due to the margins.

text: 평일 낮기준 웨이팅없이 바로입장했습니다
text_en: I got in right away without waiting on a weekday afternoon.

text: 역이랑 조금 먼데 걸어올만 하고 성수에서 꼭 가봐야 될 카페에요!!
text_en: It's a bit far from the station, but it's worth a walk, and it's a must-visit cafe in Seongsu!!

text: 줄 서서 4개씩 이나 사야할 만큼 대단한 맛은 아녜요.
text_en: The taste isn't so great that you have to stand in line and buy 4 of them.

text: 😍😍 주변에 트리도 있고, 이벤트 공간도 있어서 음식 받으러 왔다갔다 할 때 복작복작 했지만 일행들과 즐기기에는 부족함이 없었네요!
text_en: 😍😍 There was a tree nearby and an event space, so it was a bit complicated to go back and forth to get food, but it was enough to enjoy with my friends!

text: 성수동에서 서울숲 넘어가는 길 항상 지나치는 골목길에 있어 궁금했는데~~ 커피 너무 맛있어요!
text_en: I was curious about this because it was in an alley that I always passed on the way from Seongsu-dong to Seoul Forest. The coffee was so delicious!

text: 들어가보니 인테리어도 너무 예쁘고 사진도 잘나오는 분위기라 더 좋았습니다.
text_en: When I went in, I liked the interior because it was very pretty and the atmosphere took good pictures.

text: 아아가 생각보다 저렴했고 디저트도 맛있어요

text: 😂 빵나오는 시간 맞춰서가서 그래도 한 10분정도만 기다렸던 것 같아요.
text_en: 😂 I went just in time for the bread to come out, but I think I only waited about 10 minutes.

text: 좌석도 편하고 음악도 집중하기좋아요
text_en: The seats are comfortable and the music is good for concentrating.

text: 줄 없으면 1,2개 사먹을수도 있지만 줄도 서, 갑자기 끊음(?) 무조건 최소 12,000원 사야되고.
text_en: If there is no line, you can buy 1 or 2 pieces, but there is a line, and it suddenly cuts off(?). You have to buy at least 12,000 won.

text: 썸머라떼 너무 맛있구 프토도 진짜 맛있어욤!
text_en: The summer latte is so delicious and the pto is really delicious too!

text: 금요일 점심 방문했고 대기 그렇게 많지 않앗어요!
text_en: Visited for lunch on a Friday and there wasn't that much of a wait!

text: 베통 줄 서는 김에 자연도도 샀음

text: 입규를 찾기가 힘들었러요.

text: 다음엔 사서 바로 먹어야지
text_en: Next time I will buy it and eat it right away.

text_en: I felt depressed after leaving the company, but we received a lot of comfort together!!

text: 걍 다른곳과 비슷한 가격인데 세트로 4개같이 구매해야하며 인테리어가 멋있어용

text: 웨이팅 없이 들어갔고, 여러가지 종류 요청했는데 보는 사람이 많아서 그런지 후보있으면 알려달라고 하시더라구요,,

text: 코리안 믹스커피를 이렇게 재현해내다니, 감탄입니당!
text_en: I'm amazed that you can recreate Korean mixed coffee like this!

text: 여기 소금빵 맛본 이후로 이거밖에 못먹겠음 ..
text_en: Ever since I tasted the salt bread here, this is the only thing I can eat..

text: 세련된 분위기가 참 좋았고, 커피도 생각보다 훨씬 맛있었어요.
text_en: I really liked the sophisticated atmosphere, and the coffee was much better than I expected.

text: 워낙 유명한 곳인데 지나다가 사람들이 몇명 없어서 사봤어요.
text_en: It's a very famous place, but I passed by and saw few people so I bought it.

text: 오늘은 성수매장으로~~ 항상 웨이팅은 기본 소금빵은 역쉬 자연도가 최고예요
text_en: Today we go to the Seongsu store~~ There is always a wait, and the salt bread is naturally the best.

text: 냄새에 홀려 줄을 서게 됐는데 특이하게도 키오스크에 시간별로 결제를 하게 되어있고, 한세트에 무조건 4개씩 팔더라구요!
text_en: I was captivated by the smell and had to wait in line, but strangely, the kiosk allowed you to pay by the hour, and they always sold 4 pieces per set!

text: 성수동 팝업갔다 우연히 발견한 믹스커피맛집 달달구리 더위사냥 아이스크림맛 ♡ 더울때 한잔 마시니 에너지 업 오란다두 맛있구~~ 밖에 테이블 있어용~
text_en: I went to a pop-up in Seongsu-dong and stumbled across a mixed coffee restaurant called Daldalguri. It tastes like heat-killing ice cream ♡ Drinking a cup when it's hot gives you energy. Oranda is delicious~~ There's a table outside~

text: 지난번 줄이 넘 길어 못 먹어서 오늘은 후다닥 포장해서 사감..
text_en: Last time the line was so long I couldn't eat, so I packed it up today and bought it.

text: 2만원 커피가격보다 더 많은 만족감과 힐링하고 왔습니다
text_en: I received more satisfaction and healing than the price of 20,000 won coffee.

text: 평일에 가니 한적하고 좋네요
text_en: It's nice and quiet if you go on a weekday.

text: 먹기 좋은 방법 알려주신대로 빵 속을 살짝 파낸 후, 별도로 챙겨주신 크럼블을 안에 부어 함께 먹으면 달콤하고 고소한 견과류의 깊은 풍미까지 더해준 덕에 계속 퍼먹게 되던 디저트로 단연 이 날의 원픽!
text_en: The best way to eat it is by scooping out the inside of the bread as you suggested, then pouring the crumble that was provided separately inside and eating it together. It adds a deep flavor of sweet and savory nuts, making it a dessert that I keep eating, and it is definitely my favorite of the day!

text: 자연도소금빵이 맛있다고 들었는데 정말 우연찮게 보게되서 살수있었답니다
text_en: I heard that Jayeondo Salt Bread was delicious, and I was able to buy it because I saw it by chance.

text: 식었는데도 맛있고, 전자레인지에 뎁혀먹으니 갓 구운듯 촉촉 고소 짭쪼름 쫄깃 따뜻하니 맛있었어요!
text_en: It was delicious even when it was cold, and when I heated it in the microwave, it was moist, salty, chewy, warm, and delicious as if it had been freshly baked!

text: 다른 것들도 그렇지만 리뷰 이벤트로 주신 파인콘도 맛있었어요!
text_en: As with everything else, the pine cone given as a review event was delicious!

text: 추천받아 갔는데 친절하게 설명도 잘 해주시고 차도 맛있었어요
text_en: I went there after it was recommended, and the explanation was kind and the tea was delicious.

text: 소금빵 사진을 못 찍었네요
text_en: I didn't take a picture of the salt bread.

text: 더운 날 강아지 동반 가능한 카페 찾기 힘들었는데~ 넘 반갑게 들어와서 쉬다가요~ 우연히 들렀는데, 공간이 넓어서 좋았어요.
text_en: It was hard to find a cafe that allowed dogs on a hot day, but I was so happy to come in and have a rest. I stopped by by chance, and it was nice because the space was spacious.

text: 오랜만에 방문하는 자연도🥐 갈 때마다 사람이 많이 그냥 지나쳤는데, 이 날은 소금빵 냄새가 너무 좋아서 기다려서 소금빵을 사왔습니당
text_en: It's been a while since I visited Nature🥐 Every time I go, a lot of people just pass by, but on this day, the smell of salt bread was so good that I waited and bought some salt bread.

text: 버터리하고 너무 맛나요!!
text_en: Buttery and so delicious!!

text: 조용히 책읽거나 얘기 나누기 좋아요!
text_en: Great for quietly reading a book or talking!

text: 올라가는 크림이 부드럽고 달달하고 진했습니다
text_en: The cream that went up was soft, sweet, and rich.

text: 에스프레소에 취약한 사람들도 마시기 쉬운 스타일이라서 시그니처는 다 드셔보시길 권유하고 싶어요
text_en: I would like to recommend that people who are weak to espresso try all of the signature styles because they are easy to drink.

text: ❤️ 포토존 이렇게 많은 곳 너무너무 오랜만인데 웬만한 스튜디오보다 더 아름다운곳🥺 디저트랑 음료도 비주얼 장난아닌데 맛 더 미쳐버림..
text_en: ❤️ It's been a long time since I've seen so many photo zones, but this place is more beautiful than most studios🥺 The desserts and drinks are no joke, but the taste is even crazier...

text: 여긴 찐이에여… 여길가려고 간 건 아니구요… 걷다가 길거리에 퍼진 버터냄새로 유혹 당해서 홀려서 샀어요… 이 냄새 뭐지…
text_en: This is Jjin... I didn't go here to go... While I was walking, I was tempted by the smell of butter on the street, so I bought it... What is this smell...

text: 저번에 찻잎을 구매하고 받은 쿠폰을 쓰러왔는데 살짝 문제가 있었지만 친절하게 대응해주셔서 맛있게 잘 먹고 좋은 기억 남기고 왔네요.
text_en: I used the coupon I received after purchasing tea leaves last time, and there was a slight problem, but they responded kindly, so I enjoyed the meal and left with good memories.

text: 소금빵 갓 나와서 엄청 따끈하고 버터도 가득 들었는지 부드럽고 맛있어요
text_en: The salt bread is freshly made, very warm, and full of butter, so soft and delicious.

text: 예전부터 성수동에 자연도소금빵 있는 거 알고 있었는데 좀 늦게 이제야 들렸어요
text_en: I've known for a long time that there is a Jayeondo Salt Bread in Seongsu-dong, but I only heard about it a little late.

text: 테이블끼리 좀 가깝다 느껴지는데 딱히 불편하진않네오!!

text: 명장님이 직접 내어주신 초코에 반하다에 반하고, 자극적이지 않은 파바게트와 발효팥은 사용한 달지않은 단팥빵의 맛이 참 좋습니다.
text_en: I fell in love with the chocolate served by the chef himself, and the taste of the mild sweet red bean bread made with mild fabaguette and fermented red beans is really good.

text: 웨이팅이 길어보여도 빵 받아가는건 순식간이라 내차례가 금방 옵니다
text_en: Even though the wait seems long, it's quick to get the bread so my turn comes quickly.

text: 느끼하다는 평도 많은데 독보적인 맛이라 딴거 먹으면 만족이 안돼서 문제입니다,,,, 차라리 여기 소금빵 맛이 제스타일이 아니었으면 좋겠어요
text_en: There are many reviews saying that it is greasy, but the problem is that it is unrivaled in taste and I am not satisfied when I eat other things. I wish the taste of the salt bread here was not my style.

text: 인테리어가 멋지고 조용해서 좋아요
text_en: I like that the interior is nice and quiet.

text: 테이크아웃 할인되서 좋아요
text_en: I like the takeout discount.

text: 시그니처 메뉴라고 해서 기대했는데 신기하게 상큼달콤하고 쌉싸름한게 아주 특별했습니다.
text_en: I had high expectations because it was a signature dish, but it was surprisingly sweet and bitter, making it very special.

text: 아직 끝나지 않은 여름, 거리를 걷다가 우연찮게 들렀는데 분위기도 좋고, 음악도 좋고, 음료도 맛있어요.
text_en: Summer isn't over yet, and I happened to stop by while walking down the street. The atmosphere was good, the music was good, and the drinks were delicious.

text: 진짜 존맛탱…네 개 사서 혼자 세개 순삭 너무 맛있음.
text_en: Really delicious... I bought four and ate three by myself. They were so delicious.

text: 그런데 거기도 소금빵을 잘만드는 파티시에가 그만 두었을때 소금빵은 그야말로 축축 하면서 맛이 없었고 그렇게 맛있는 소금빵을 찾아 나섰지만 다 거기서 거기 였다
text_en: However, when the pastry chef who was good at making salt bread quit, the salt bread was soggy and tasteless. I went looking for delicious salt bread, but it was all there.

text: 시그니처라서 궁금해서 시켜봤는데 달달한에스프레소에 크레마라서 맛있어요.
text_en: I ordered it because I was curious because it was a signature dish, and it was delicious because it had sweet espresso and crema.

text: 커피너무맛있어요!!
text_en: The coffee is so delicious!!

text: 빵나오는 시간 오전 9시 오후 12시30 오후 2시 오후 3시30 오후 5시 오후 6시30
text_en: Bread serving time: 9:00 AM, 12:30 PM, 2:00 PM, 3:30 PM, 5:00 PM, 6:30 PM

text: 고소한 버터내음이 지나치기 힘들고 갓 구워나온 따뜻한 소금빵 한입 베어물면 그 자리에서 순삭이에요
text_en: It's hard to miss the fragrant smell of butter, and when you take a bite of the freshly baked warm salt bread, you'll eat it right away.

text: 4개나 들어있지만 맛있어서 한 봉지 뚝딱입니다.
text_en: There are 4 of them, but they are so delicious that you can easily get a whole bag.

text: 커피도 달달하고 맛있어서 완벽한 카페에요~
text_en: The coffee is sweet and delicious, so it’s the perfect cafe.

text: 평소 소금빵을 돈 주고 사먹어 본 적이 별로 없는데 자연도 소금빵은 평이 좋아 꼭 먹어보고 싶어 다녀왔습니다
text_en: I've never paid for salt bread before, but Jayeondo's salt bread has good reviews so I really wanted to try it.

text: 귀여운 교동이 생일 축하파티💙🩵 너무 좋았어요~
text_en: Cute Gyodong’s birthday celebration party💙🩵 I loved it~

text: 웨이팅을 할 정도의 존맛집이라고 생각은 안되는데, 가게 될 일이 생기고 줄이 짧다면 선물하거나 한 세트 사기엔 좋음
text_en: I don't think it's a good restaurant where you have to wait, but if you happen to go there and the line is short, it's a good place to give as a gift or buy a set.

text: 음료도 상큼하고 맛있습니다
text_en: The drinks are refreshing and delicious too.

text: 가야지 하다가 이제왔는데 제가 좋아하는 식감이라 저는 맛있게먹었어요!
text_en: I was thinking about going, but now it's here and I enjoyed it because it's the texture I like!

text: 🥹 앉은 자리에서 혼자 4개 클리어 쌉가능입니다
text_en: 🥹 It is possible to clear 4 items by yourself in one sitting.

text: 야외공간도 넓고 해서 이벤트 같은 거 하기 좋아보였어요
text_en: The outdoor space was large, so it seemed like a good place to hold an event.

text: 생긴지 얼마 안된거 같은데, 위치가 성수동과 서울숲 중간쯤에 위치해서 걷다가 긴급 카페인 땡겨서 들어가게 됐음.
text_en: I don't think it's been around for a while, but it's located about halfway between Seongsu-dong and Seoul Forest, so while I was walking, I was in the mood for an emergency cafe, so I went in there.

text: 디저트는 거의 다 나가있어서 나오는 시간대 기다리다가 먹을 예정입니다 _
text_en: Almost all of the desserts are sold out, so I'm planning to wait and eat them when they come out.

text: 제게 성수는 마음 먹고 오는 곳이기에 (거리적으로) 한 번 방문할 때 후회 없이 성수를 즐기고 오고 싶어 갈 곳을 알아보던 중, 우연히 구테로이테의 커피 오마카세를 알게 되었어요!
text_en: For me, Seongsu is a place I make up my mind to come to (distance-wise), so I wanted to enjoy Seongsu without regrets once I visit, so while I was looking for a place to go, I happened to come across Guteroite's Coffee Omakase!

text: 뚝섬역 최근에 자주오게 되는데 요즘 뚝섬역에서 간 카페중 가장 제 스타일이고 제 감성에 맞는 거 같아요!
text_en: I've been coming to Ttukseom Station a lot lately, and out of all the cafes I've been to at Ttukseom Station these days, I think this one has my style and suits my sensibilities the most!

text: 음악좋고 분위기 핫해요!!
text_en: The music is good and the atmosphere is hot!!

text: 라떼는 우유와 에스프레소의 밸런스가 정말 잘 맞아서 고소하면서도 깔끔한 뒷맛이 인상적이었고, 레몬에이드는 상큼함 속에 은은한 허브향이 더해져 산뜻하게 즐기기 좋았어요.
text_en: The latte had a really good balance between milk and espresso, so it had an impressive savory yet clean aftertaste, and the lemonade was refreshing and had a subtle herbal scent, so it was nice to enjoy it refreshingly.

text: 갈때마다 웨이팅이 있어서 그냥 갈까 하지만 그냥 갈 수 없는 맛🫶🏻✨
text_en: Every time I go, there's a wait, so I think I'll just go, but it's so delicious that I can't just go there🫶🏻✨

text: 들어가서 마실려면 웨이팅 좀 있었어요!
text_en: There was a bit of a wait to get in and drink!

text: 그대로네용 성수에서 산 친구는 점심쯔음가서 웨이팅 좀 했다던데 전 퇴근후 바로 가니까 웨이팅없이 바로 받았어요
text_en: It's the same. My friend who lived in Seongsu said there was a wait because he went around lunchtime, but I went right after work, so I got it right away without a wait.

text: 맨날 갈때마다 줄이 너무 길어서 포기했었는데 이 날은 줄이 별로 없어서 (저희 줄 서고 겁나 길어짐;;) 드디어 사먹어봤는데 역시 줄 서는 집은 맛집이어따👍
text_en: Every time I go there, the line is so long that I gave up, but on this day, there wasn't much of a line (our line got really long;;), so I finally tried to buy it, and as expected, the restaurant where there is a line is a good restaurant👍

text: ⭐️ 케이크 종류도 많고 맛있어요
text_en: ⭐️There are many types of cakes and they are delicious.

text: 친구 추천으로 온 건데, 분위기도 너무 좋고 특별한 시그니처 메뉴들이 많아서 좋아요!
text_en: I came here on a recommendation from a friend, and I like the atmosphere and the many special signature menu items!

text: 재방문의사 완전 높음!
text_en: The intention to revisit is very high!

text: 날좋을때 한번가고 날 안좋을때 가면 안으로 들어가야 해서 답답해요
text_en: It's frustrating because I have to go once when the weather is good and then go inside when the weather is bad.

text: 겉바속쫄🫨 커피는 오리지널말고 볶은쌀맛 먹었는데 부드럽고 고소해서 술술 잘 넘어갔어요… 볶은쌀맛 강추입니다
text_en: Jjol on the outside🫨 I had the roasted rice flavored coffee instead of the original, and it was smooth and savory, so I drank it well... I highly recommend the roasted rice flavor.

text: 성수동 나들이 중 이렇게 친절하신 분들 처음;; (그렇다고 다른곳이 불친절 하다는건 아니고요) 인테리어 정말 멋있고 자리도 널~찍해 좋았어요.
text_en: This is my first time seeing such kind people during my outing in Seongsu-dong;; (That doesn't mean other places are unfriendly.) The interior was really nice and the seating was spacious.

text: 저는 성수동에서 이 집 커피랑 케익이 제일 맛있는 것 같아요!
text_en: I think the coffee and cake here are the best in Seongsu-dong!

text: (제 기준 하드 소금빵은 성북동이 일등!!)
text_en: (For my hard salt bread, Seongbuk-dong is the best!!)

text: 가족들과 나눠먹으려 여러개 샀고 12:30타임에 갔는데 9시타임꺼 남은 수량인지 받자마자 만져봤을때도 다 식어있었습니다.
text_en: I bought several to share with my family and went at 12:30, but when I touched it as soon as I received it to see if there were any left for the 9:00 time, they were all cold.

text: 이 정도 맛에 스페셜 메뉴에 디카페인까지 되다니 완전 강추입니다.
text_en: With this level of flavor, a special menu, and even decaf, I highly recommend it.

text: 종류별로 많이 시켜서 마시면 더 좋아요
text_en: It's better if you order a lot of different types and drink it.

text: 다음에도 곁들여 먹으려구요!
text_en: I plan to eat it with it next time too!

text: 깔끔하고 엄청 신경써서 준비해주신게 느껴지는 곳입니다
text_en: It's a clean place and you can feel that a lot of care was taken in preparing it.

text: 원래 겉비속촉 크랙있는 소금빵 좋아하는데 여기꺼는 말랑말랑 부드러운 식감인데도 버터 풍미가 좋아서 맛있네요.
text_en: I usually like salt bread with cracks on the outside and inside, but this one has a soft and soft texture but has a nice buttery flavor, so it's delicious.

text: 르세라핌 팝업으로 다녀왔어요 공간도 넓고 깔쌈하고 좋았네요!
text_en: I went to the Le Seraphim pop-up. The space was spacious, cozy, and nice!

text: 바람쐬러 을왕리 해수욕장 왔다가 인테리어가 너무 멋져서 들러봄!
text_en: I came to Eurwangni Beach to get some fresh air and stopped by because the interior was so cool!

text: 진짜 진짜 버터동굴 미쳤고 바닥은 콰작해요 강추.
text_en: The butter cave is really crazy and the floor is very rocky. I highly recommend it.

text: 줄이 어마무시 ..
text_en: The line is huge...

text: 👍🏻 시그니처인 스테포스트 블랙 마셨는데 흑임자 라떼라서 달달하고 고소해서 너무 맛있었어요!!
text_en: 👍🏻 I drank the signature Stepost Black, and it was a black sesame latte, so it was sweet and savory, so it was delicious!!

text: 최고 차 맛, 분위기, 인테리어, 음악까지 이렇게 완벽한 카페는 정말 오랜만이에요.
text_en: It's been a long time since I've seen a cafe this perfect, with the best tea taste, atmosphere, interior, and music.

text: 공차 테이크아웃 해서 서울숲 산책하는 루틴 ..
text_en: Routine of taking out Gongcha and taking a walk in Seoul Forest...

text: 군더더기없는 깔끔인테리어에 시원하고 넓어서 좋아요.
text_en: I like that it's cool and spacious with a clean, no-frills interior.

text: 에스프레소 및 커피 배리에이션 음료가 독특해서 커피쟁이에게는 만족스런 카페
text_en: A cafe that satisfies coffee lovers with unique espresso and coffee variations.

text: 아니면 혹시 보관상의 문제때문에 냄새가 났던건지 큼큼한 냄새가 나서 찜찜해서 못먹었어요
text_en: Or maybe it was because of a storage problem, but the smell was so strong that I couldn't eat it.

text: 플랫화이트는 넘 진하고 맛있네용
text_en: The flat white is very rich and delicious.

text: 커피에 대한 설명도 참 자세해서 참고해 맛보기 좋았어요:) 매장 이용시에도 일회용 컵으로 주셔서 쓰레기 걱정이 되긴했습니다..
text_en: The explanation of the coffee was very detailed, so it was nice to refer to it and taste it :) I was worried about waste because they gave me disposable cups when using the store.

text: 생일파티는 4일 굿즈는 떨어진지 오래라고 안내하시는 직원분 그러면 늦은시간까지 예약을 하고 방문하는 이유가 없는거 같습니다
text_en: The staff informs me that the birthday party is on the 4th and that they have long since run out of goods, so I guess there is no reason to make a reservation and visit until late at night.

text: 🤣🤣 시끄럽지않아서 미팅하기에도 좋았어요!!
text_en: 🤣🤣 It was good for meetings because it wasn’t noisy!!

text: 공간이 넓고 콘센트도 있어서 편하게 쉬었다 갈 수 있어요.
text_en: The space is spacious and there are outlets, so you can rest comfortably.

text: 분위기도 좋구 커피 맛도 좋아요
text_en: The atmosphere is nice and the coffee tastes good.

text: 여기가 그 사진맛집, 커피&디저트 맛집인가용 평일 오후에도 사람이 엄청 많았던 핫플카페 였어요!!
text_en: Is this the photo restaurant or coffee and dessert restaurant? It was a hot cafe that was very crowded even on a weekday afternoon!!

text: 음악도 잔잔하니 카페분위기도 끝내주었습니다 ><
text_en: The music was soothing and the cafe atmosphere was great ><

text: 겨울 오마카세가 끝나서 아쉽지만 다음 시즌 코스를 기다리며 에스프레소 코스를 마셨습니다.
text_en: It's a shame that the winter omakase is over, but I drank the espresso course while waiting for the next season's course.

text: 하루에 칠천개 판다더니 낱개로는 못사고 4개 한세트로만 팔아서 칠천개를 파나봐요
text_en: They say they sell 7,000 pieces a day, but they can't buy them individually. They only sell them in sets of 4, so they sell 7,000 pieces.

text: 전혀 느끼하지도 적당한 겉바속촉에 손에 기름도 잘 묻어 나지도 않음.
text_en: It's not greasy at all and has a moderate texture on the outside and doesn't leave oil on your hands.

text: 카페라떼 샷에 유유섞인게 뭔 이만원 쳐넘어가노 시즌메뉴도 공차얼그레이 밀크티 음료에 식용 장미 쳐사서 넣으셈 .
text_en: I don't know why it's mixed with a cafe latte shot. It's worth over 20,000 won. The seasonal menu is also a Gongcha Earl Gray milk tea drink, and I added edible roses to it.

text: 사람들이 줄 서 있는데 맛있는 소금빵 냄새가 나서 저도 줄 서서 사보고 집에 가져와서 먹어봤는데 그냥 먹으면 촉촉쫀득한게 담백한듯 버터맛이 맛있고 에어프라이에 돌려 먹으니 훨씬 겉바속촉맛으로 먹을 수 있어요
text_en: People were standing in line, and I smelled delicious salt bread, so I stood in line to buy it, brought it home, and tried it. If you eat it as is, it is moist and light, and has a delicious buttery taste. If you air fry it, you can eat it even more moist on the outside.

text: 화장실도 깔끔해요.
text_en: The bathroom is also clean.

text: 지난 주말 점심 먹고 지나는 길에 새로 생긴 가게 앞에 줄이 길게 있더군요.
text_en: Last weekend, when I was passing by after lunch, there was a long line in front of a new store.

text: 요세 커피랑 빵값 너무 비싼데가 많아서 그런짘 금액이 참 합리적이라는 생각이 듬👍 인테리어 깔끔하고 이쁘고 작업하기도 좋은 자리 배치와 콘센트‼️ 소세지 바게트도 데워주시고(먹고 갈지 물어보고 데워준다 함) 따로 나눠서 담아주는 센스💖 라벤더 향 가득한 아인슈페너 느낌의 커피도 좋았고 뉴욕롤도 정말 맛있네요~
text_en: These days, coffee and bread are very expensive, so I think the price is very reasonable👍 The interior is clean and pretty, and the seating arrangements and outlets are good for working‼️ They even warmed up the sausage baguettes (they asked if you wanted to eat it and said they would warm it for you) and served it separately💖 I liked the Einspenner-like coffee full of lavender scent, and the New York roll was also really delicious~

text: 가족과 함께 성수동 나들이 나왔다가 방문했어요~
text_en: I visited Seongsu-dong with my family after an outing~

text: 👍 테이크아웃만 되는데 다들 이거 사려고 줄 서는 이유를 갓 나온 소금빵 한입 먹자마자 정말 0.1초만에 깨달았어요….
text_en: 👍 As soon as I took a bite of the fresh salt bread, I realized in 0.1 second why everyone was lining up to buy this even though it was only available for takeout... .

text: 음료도 맛있고 다른 디저트도 머두 궁금해지는 곳이었습니다
text_en: The drinks were delicious and I was curious about other desserts as well.

text: 인생소금빵입니다… 1개씩은 못 사고 무조건 4개씩 사야하지만 4개 살 가치 있어요
text_en: This is life salt bread... You can't buy one at a time, you have to buy four at a time, but it's worth buying four.

text: 진짜 하루종일 생각나고 앞으로 성수오면 그냥 크로플 먹으러 여기만 가고싶을 정도로 너무 부드럽고 맛있어서 완전 꽂혀버린 디저트에요
text_en: It's a dessert that I'm completely obsessed with because it's so soft and delicious that I think about it all day long and I just want to go here to eat crople when I come to Seongsu from now on.

text: 효율적인 주문 시스템으로 줄이 길어도 대기 시간이 길지 않았어요.
text_en: Even though the line was long, the waiting time was not long due to the efficient ordering system.

text: 만드는 족족 팔리나봐요 :) 😀 첫입은 과자 에이스랑 똑같아요
text_en: I guess it sells out as soon as I make it :) 😀 The first bite is the same as Ace of Cookies.

text: 살짝 아쉬운게 있으면 음악소리가 너무 커서 얘기하다 목소리도 점점 같이 커진다
text_en: If there's one thing that's a little disappointing, the music is too loud and your voice gets louder when you talk.

text: 뱅쇼까지 판매할 만큼 메뉴의 스펙트럼이 넓어 좋군요.
text_en: I like that the menu has such a wide spectrum that they even sell banjos.

text: 💛 참고로 음료 리필도 가능해서 저는 테이크아웃으로 아이스로 변경해 마셨습니당
text_en: 💛 By the way, you can refill drinks, so I changed to iced drinks for takeout.

text: 최애 소금빵집,, 성수 가면 꼭 필수로 사는 곳이에요,, 가끔 소금빵이 먹고 싶어서 다른 빵집을 가면 기대에 못 미쳐서,, 성수 종로 가면 필수로 먹어용,,!
text_en: My favorite salt bakery,, this is a must-buy place when I go to Seongsu,, sometimes I want salt bread and go to another bakery, but it doesn’t meet my expectations,,,, it’s a must-eat when I go to Jongno, Seongsu,,!

text: 세상에서 제일 맛있다는 건 분명 매우 심한 과장이지만 작고 귀여운 사이즈에 부드럽고 촉촉한 식감의 빵, 짭짤한 맛으로 버터가 엄청 들어가 버터 동굴과 버터 바닥이 확실히 존재하여 버터 풍미가 장난 아님
text_en: To say that it is the most delicious in the world is definitely a gross exaggeration, but it is a small and cute bread with a soft and moist texture, a salty taste, and a lot of butter. There is a butter cave and a butter bottom, so the butter flavor is no joke.

text: 저렴하지는 않지만 다양한 디저트가 있음
text_en: Not cheap but has a variety of desserts

text: 불쌍한 표정을 짓고 있는 강쥐 쿠션🤎 전에 지나가다가 강아지인줄 알고 놀랬어여!
text_en: A cat cushion with a pitiful expression🤎 I was surprised when I passed by it and thought it was a dog!

text: 인테리어도 너무 예쁘고 디저트도 맛있었던 신논현역 카페에요 :) 황치즈 파운드케이크와 우지말차 푸딩스콘 두 가지 먹었는데 둘다 넘 맛있고 매력있어서 만족스럽습니당
text_en: It's a Shinnonhyeon Station cafe with a very pretty interior and delicious desserts :) I had two things: yellow cheese pound cake and Uji matcha pudding scone, and I'm satisfied because they were both very delicious and attractive.

text: 다양한 티와 디저트를 즐기며 통창 너머로 성수동이 내려다볼 수 있는 힐링 스폿 ..
text_en: A healing spot where you can enjoy a variety of teas and desserts while looking out over Seongsu-dong through the large windows..

text: 카페라떼 별모양 아트가 넘 이쁘고 커피맛도 좋고 분위기에 감동ᆢ 고급스러움의 극치ᆢ 가족끼리 대화나누기에도 넘 좋았습니다
text_en: The cafe latte's star-shaped art was very pretty, the coffee tasted good, and I was impressed by the atmosphere. It was the ultimate in luxury. It was also great for conversations with family.

text: 공간이 시원시원 넓고 음악도 좋았어요~
text_en: The space was cool and spacious and the music was good~

text: 봉투에 4개의 소금빵이 들어있는데 다른집 소금빵과 다른 점은 버터향이 진하고 하루가 지나서 먹었는데도 바삭함이 그대로였어요.
text_en: There are 4 salt breads in the bag. What makes them different from other salt breads is that they have a strong buttery flavor and are still crispy even after eating them a day later.

text: 에스프레소가 맛있어요:D 시그니처부터 파인콘같은 기본메뉴까지 싹 다 마셔보고 싶네요!!
text_en: The espresso is delicious :D I want to try everything from the signature menu to the basic menu items like Pine Cone!!

text: 😭 너무 느끼하고 짜서 먹다가 중도 포기 했고 다음날 아침에 먹었는데 짠맛 조금 덜하거 같긴한데 그래도 너무 짜더라고요.
text_en: 😭 I gave up on eating it because it was too greasy and salty. I ate it the next morning and it seemed to be a little less salty, but it was still too salty.

text: 지날때마다 빵냄새가 너무 좋고 줄이 길어서 도전해봤습니다
text_en: Every time I passed by, the smell of bread was so good and the line was long, so I gave it a try.

text: 패스트리의 버터가 겹겹이 아니라 중간에 넣었고 짭쪼름한 맛이라 표현하고 싶네요.
text_en: The butter in the pastry was put in the middle instead of in layers, and I would like to describe it as having a salty taste.

text: 몇 번 계속 먹어봐도 런던 베이글, 아티스트베이커리에 미치지 못하는 것 같습니다.
text_en: No matter how many times I try it, it doesn't seem to be as good as London Bagel or Artist Bakery.

text: 성수동 올때마다 방앗간 못 지나치는 참새 마냥 꼭 들르는 에스프레소 바 입니다
text_en: This is an espresso bar that I always stop by every time I come to Seongsu-dong, like a sparrow that can't pass by the mill.

text: 버터향이 너무 좋아요
text_en: I love the smell of butter

text: 직원분들 다 너무 친절하셔서 더 즐거웠어요!
text_en: The staff were all so friendly that it was even more enjoyable!

text: 인테리어도 우드톤에 카페가 따뜻해보여요:) 야외 좌석도 있어서 날씨 좋은날에는 밖에서 마셔도 굿😀
text_en: The interior is wood-toned and the cafe looks warm:) There is also outdoor seating, so it's nice to drink outside on nice days😀

text: 케이크도 맛보고 싶은데 솔드아웃 담에 또 올게요
text_en: I want to try the cake too, but I'll come again next time it's sold out.

text: 낱개로 살 수는 없고 4개를 한 번에 사야하지만 여러 개 사길 잘한 게 맛있어서 순삭했어요
text_en: You can't buy them individually, you have to buy 4 at once, but it was a good idea to buy several because they were so delicious.

text: 남자분 혼자 빵 담고 포장하고 옆에 계신 두 여자분은 영수증 확인하고.
text_en: The man put and packaged the bread alone, while the two women next to him checked the receipt.

text: 4개가 한 봉다리안에 들려있어서 몇개세트인지로만 말하면 되요
text_en: There are 4 in one bag, so you can just tell me how many sets there are.

text: 일단 분위기 넘 감성적이고 예뻐서 아이들도 좋아할것 같아요
text_en: First of all, the atmosphere is very emotional and pretty, so I think kids will like it too.

text: 찾아가는 길은 좀 어렵지만 성수역까지 대로가 쭉 보이는 멋진 뷰를 보면서 차 한잔 여유롭게 할 수 있어서 좋았어요
text_en: The road to get there is a bit difficult, but it was nice to be able to have a leisurely cup of tea while looking at the wonderful view of the main road all the way to Seongsu Station.

text: 맛있구 분위기도 좋아용!
text_en: It's delicious and the atmosphere is great!

text: 시그니처 메뉴도 있었고 주문 받으시는 직원 분이 메뉴 사진 보여주셔요~ 친절하셨어용
text_en: There was a signature menu, and the staff member who took the order showed me a photo of the menu. He was very friendly.

text: 맛은 일반 소금빵인데 버터가 많이 들어가 있어서 부드러웠어요
text_en: It tastes like regular salt bread, but it was soft because it had a lot of butter in it.

text: 지나가다가 꼭 한번 와보고 싶었는데 운 좋게 밖에 앉을 수 있었네요~
text_en: I was passing by and wanted to come here, but I was lucky enough to be able to sit outside.

text: 살살녹는 겉바속촉 프렌치토스트와 푸딩스콘이 너무너무 맛있었던.
text_en: The melt-in-your-mouth French toast and pudding scones were so delicious.

text: 공차가서 돈 아까운건 또 처음
text_en: This is the first time I've wasted money by going to Gongcha.

text: 공간도 예쁘고 특별한 티 베리에이션 메뉴가 많아서 너무 좋았습니다.
text_en: I really liked the space because it was pretty and there were many special tea variations on the menu.

text: 외관이 신기하고 멋있어서 저녁식사 후에 가 보았는데 음료가 상당히 비싸다고 느껴졌습니다
text_en: The exterior looked amazing and cool, so I went there after dinner, but I felt that the drinks were quite expensive.

text: 커피가 너무 맛있어요!!
text_en: The coffee is so delicious!!

text: 얼그레이케익대박!!
text_en: Earl gray cake is awesome!!

text: 분위기도 좋고, 커피도 깊은 풍미를 자랑하는 곳인데, 뚝섬역에서 가까워 접근성도 좋고, 성수동 맛집을 다녀온 후 서울숲으로 가는 길에 잠시 들러 쉬어가기 좋은 곳이네요:)
text_en: It's a place with a nice atmosphere and a rich flavor of coffee. It's close to Ttukseom Station, so it's easily accessible, and it's a great place to stop by and rest for a while on the way to Seoul Forest after visiting a restaurant in Seongsu-dong. :)

text: 두번째 이용인데 케이크도 맛있고 예뻐서 특별한 날 기념하려고 하면 제일 먼저 생각나는 곳 입니다.ᐟ
text_en: This is my second time using it, and the cakes are delicious and pretty, so this is the first place that comes to mind when I want to celebrate a special day.ᐟ

text: 화장실 내참 화장실을 찍고 있는 거임?!
text_en: Are you really taking pictures of the bathroom?!

text: 전에 왔을때 직원분이 너무 불친절하셔서 계속 영종도로만 갔다가 오늘 간만에 방문했는데 걍 ㄱㅊ았어요 빵은 걍 졸라맛있음
text_en: When I came here before, the staff was so unfriendly that I kept going to Yeongjongdo. I visited today for the first time in a while and it was just okay. The bread was just soggy and delicious.

text: 고층에있다는 점이 특별하고 아늑한 공간에 바 테이블로 에워싼 인테리어가 차를 즐기는 시간을 한층 더 은은하게 해줘서 좋아요
text_en: The fact that it's on a high floor makes it special, and the cozy space with an interior surrounded by bar tables makes the time of enjoying tea even more subtle.

text: 😻😻 진짜 버터 처돌이 소금빵 처돌이인데 진심 개맛있음
text_en: 😻😻 It's a real butter Cheodori and salt bread Cheodori, and it's seriously delicious.

text: 저는 원래 크림커피를 좋아하는데 내부 포스터에 크림커피가 그려져 있어서 바로 시켰어요
text_en: I usually like cream coffee, but the poster inside showed cream coffee, so I ordered it right away.

text: 바스번, 스콘, 빅토리아 케이크를 주문했는데 바스번은 촉촉하고 부드러운 식감이라 브런치 메뉴로도 잘 어울릴 것 같아요
text_en: I ordered bath buns, scones, and Victoria cake. The bath buns have a moist and soft texture, so I think they would go well with a brunch menu.

text: 소금빵 맛집으로 인정~!
text_en: Recognized as a salt bread restaurant!

text: 더운 날씨에 음료는 필수 애플망고그림에이드,블루소다 레몸에이드 그리고 클래식 딥 쇼콜라 모두 시원하고 당충전하기 딱이었다.
text_en: Drinks are essential in hot weather. Apple Mango Grimade, Blue Soda Lemonade, and Classic Deep Chocolat were all refreshing and perfect for filling up your sugar intake.

text: 뭣보다 일단 맛있어서 입도 즐겁고 미디어아트+노래덕에 눈, 귀도 즐거운 밤이었습니다.
text_en: Above all, it was a night that was delicious and a delight to the mouth, and also to the eyes and ears thanks to the media art and songs.

text: 나이쓔타이밍~ 🫶🏼 따끔따끈 소금빵은 증맬루 잊지못해!
text_en: Good timing~ 🫶🏼 I can’t forget the spicy salt bread!

text: 시멘트케이크포장해서 먹었는데 너무너무 맛있었어요!!:)
text_en: I ate the cement cake packaged and it was so delicious!!:)

text: 짠맛도 과하지 않아 끝까지 부담 없이 먹을 수 있었고, 구운 버터의 향과 소금의 감칠맛이 아주 조화로웠습니다.
text_en: It wasn't too salty, so I was able to eat it all the way to the end, and the aroma of the roasted butter and the rich taste of the salt were in perfect harmony.

text: 카페가 넓어서 많이 시끄럽지않아서 대화하기도 좋고 인테리어도 깔끔해용
text_en: The cafe is spacious so it's not too noisy so it's good for conversation and the interior is clean.

text: 1층이랑 2층도 너무 이쁘게 꾸며놔서 올라가고 싶었는데 시간이 없어서 못올라 가봐서 아쉬웠어서 다음에 가면 꼭 시간 보내고 싶어요!
text_en: The first and second floors were decorated so beautifully that I wanted to go up, but I was disappointed that I couldn't go up because I didn't have time, so I definitely want to spend time next time I go!

text: 사고 다음날 설명대로 에프에 돌려먹었는데 많이 기름져서 저는 개인적으로 별로였지만 다른 가족들은 맛있다고 하시네요 :)
text_en: The day after the accident, I ate it again as instructed, but it was very greasy, so I personally didn't like it, but other family members said it was delicious :)

text: This is hot place in Seongsu Street, an young and lively place with many restaurants, cafes and pop up stores. Its head quarter is in Yeongjongdo but its Seongsu branch is also popular. It has long waiting line, so if in weekends or Friday evening, you have to think at least 20-30 minutes to wait. The bread is delectable, tasty salty and soft inside with good flavors. It is the one worth waiting.

It has long waiting line, so if in weekends or Friday evening, you have to think at least 20-30 minutes to wait. The bread is delectable, tasty salty and soft inside with good flavors. text: 진짜 친절하시구 최고예요
text_en: You are really kind and the best.

text: 빵이랑 디저트 종류가 다양하고 맛있어요.
text_en: The bread and desserts are varied and delicious.

text: ❣️ 무조건 크로플은 필수에 바닐라 아이스크림도 추기해서 드세요!!

text: 분위기게 부담스럽지 않게 깔리는 로우파이 음악이 매력적이네요~~
text_en: The low-fi music that creates a comfortable atmosphere is attractive.

text: 📮 시그니처라떼인 '스테포스트 블랙' 흑임자라떼가 고소하니 맛있어요:) 흑임자크림이 꾸덕하게 올라간줄 알았는데 얇게 올라가있어요!
text_en: 📮 The signature latte, 'Steppost Black' black sesame latte, is savory and delicious :) I thought the black sesame cream was thick, but it was thin!

text: 저만 알고싶은데 흑흑 아주 조금만 유명해졌으면 좋겠어요
text_en: I just want to know, but I hope I become just a little bit famous.

text: 분위기도 좋지만 무엇보다 커피가 너무 맛있어요.
text_en: The atmosphere is nice, but most of all, the coffee is so delicious.

text: 그냥 지나가다가 우연히 들렀는데 4개에 12000원이라 좀 비싼감이 있는뎊 했지만 너무 맛있었어요
text_en: I was just passing by and stopped by. It seemed a bit expensive at 12,000 won for 4, but it was very delicious.

text: 밀은 캐나다산, ,프랑스 버터에 햇빛과 바람이 만든 프랑스 토판 천일염으로 만든다고 한다.
text_en: It is said that the wheat is made from Canada, French butter, and French Topan sea salt created by sunlight and wind.

text: 커피 음료 디저트 모두 만족 자두에이드는 넘 달지 않아 좋고 아보카도 토스트는 건강한 맛~ 오픈한지 얼마 안되서 그런지 카페도 깨끗하고 여기저기 안 예쁜곳이 없네요..

text: 자리도 많고 분위기 좋아요!!

text: 시그니처 음료답게 파인콘 특색있고 맛나더라는😚 에스프레소와 함께 씹히는 설탕에 나른한 오후 정신 바짝 깨는 느낌이랄까

text: 매장도 깨끗하고 이야기 나누기 좋았습니다
text_en: The store was clean and it was nice to chat.

text: 콘센트도 자리마다 잇어서 작업하기 좋아요
text_en: There are electrical outlets at every seat, so it's great for working.

text: 복잡한 성수에서 여유로움을 느낄 수 있는 공간이라 색다른 즐거움이었습니다!
text_en: It was a unique pleasure as it was a space where I could feel relaxed in the busy Seongsu!

text: 다만 무조건 4개 1세트로 사야만 했고(낱개x) 갓나와서 따끈한 빵인건 좋지만 집에오니 다 찌그러져 있어서 지인들한테 선물하기는 민망했어요
text_en: However, I had to buy it in a set of 4 (each x), and it was nice that it was fresh and warm, but when I got home, it was all dented, so I was embarrassed to give it as a gift to my friends.

text: 그리고 우드톤 좋아하는 저로선 커페 넘 이쁘고 위치도 넘 사람 안몰리고 좋은거 가태요
text_en: And as someone who likes wood tones, the cafe is very pretty and the location isn't overcrowded, which is nice.

text: 다만 저 작은 애기빵이 한개에 삼천원 한다는게 가격 따지지않고 디저트를 즐기는 저한테도 좀 비싸게 느껴집니다.
text_en: However, the fact that one small baby bread costs 3,000 won seems a bit expensive even to me, who enjoys desserts regardless of price.

text: 빵이 짭쪼름하니 맛있었어요!

text_en: When paying, I was asked to choose between nutty and sour coffee beans, so I chose sour coffee beans, but when I looked at the receipt later, I saw that an additional 2,000 won had been added.

text: 넓고 깨끗해서 애용해야겠어요
text_en: It's spacious and clean, so I have to use it regularly.

text: 성수동 돌아다니다가 우연히 들어와봤는데 공간이 넓어서 편하게 쉬어가기도 좋고 애스프레소도 다양한 종류가 있어서 좋았어요!!
text_en: I happened to come in while wandering around Seongsu-dong, and the space was spacious so I could relax comfortably, and it was nice to have a variety of espresso!!

text: 빵은 낱개 구매는 불가하고 4개 1세트로만 판매하니까 참고하시고, 구매 줄이랑 수령하는 줄이랑 다르니까 수령하는 줄에 한참 기다리셨다가 구매 못하는 경우 생기니까 키오스크에서 먼저 구매 후에 영수증 가지고 수령하는 줄을 따로 서는거니까 꼭!
text_en: Please note that bread cannot be purchased individually and is only sold in sets of 4. The purchase line and the pickup line are different, so you may have to wait in the pickup line for a long time and then not be able to purchase, so you have to buy at the kiosk first and stand in a separate line to receive it with your receipt, so make sure to do so!

text: 베리뱅 콘판나, 레몬 그라니따, 유자 버블브루 다른 에쏘바에는 없는 독특한 메뉴가 많아서 좋은데 맛까지 좋아서 벌써 여러 번 방문한 구테로이테 주문 실수로 오렌지 그라니따가 아니라 레몬 그라니따를 먹게 되었지만 새콤하고 맛있었고 베리뱅 콘판나와 유자 버블브루도 커피와 다른 재료의 조화가 좋았다
text_en: Berry Bang Conpanna, Lemon Granita, and Yuzu Bubble Brew. It's good because there are many unique menu items that aren't found in other Esso bars, but the taste is also good. I've already visited Guteroite several times. I made a mistake and ended up getting the lemon granita instead of the orange granita, but it was sour and delicious, and the Berry Bang Conpanna and Yuzu Bubble Brew were also good in harmony with the coffee and other ingredients.

text: 아쉽게도 따뜻할 때 먹진 못했지만 유명하다길래 소금빵 조아하는 엄마 선물로 구매했어요
text_en: Unfortunately, I couldn't eat it while it was warm, but I heard it was famous so I bought it as a gift for my mom.

text: 빵순이라면 무조건 달려가야 하는 곳 갈때마다 2봉지는 기본 거짓말 안 치고 서울사는데 영종도에 이거먹으러 세번 갔다옴 집근처에 생겨서 얼마나 행복하게요
text_en: Whenever I go to a place where I absolutely have to rush to when it comes to bread sprouts, I don't lie. I live in Seoul and went to Yeongjong Island three times to eat this. I'm so happy that it's so close to my house.

text: 우연히 발견한 소금빵집 이었는 데 소금빵을 좋아해서 너무 기대되었는데 소금빵 결제 대기줄이창 소금빵 픽업 대기줄이 있는데 안내판 못보고 픽업 대기줄에서 기다리다가 결제를 먼저 해야되는 걸 깨닫고 다시 결제 줄에서 기다렸는데 갑자기 사람 너무 많아서 결제 줄에 서있지 말고 픽업 줄에 서서 결제하라고 해서 어이가 없었네요…
text_en: I found this salt bakery by chance and I was very excited because I like salt bread. There was a salt bread payment line and a salt bread pickup line, but I didn't see the sign and waited in the pick-up line. Then, I realized I had to pay first, so I waited in the payment line again, but suddenly there were so many people that they told me to pay in the pick-up line instead of the payment line. I was dumbfounded...

text: 크루키도 맛있구 커피도 원두 선택할수있어서 좋아요 :)
text_en: The Crooky is delicious and it's nice that you can choose the coffee beans :)

text: 사진찍기도 너무 좋고 쾌적하고 무엇보다 분위기가 진짜 제가 좋아하는 분위기였어서 좋았습니댜,,,
text_en: It was very nice and comfortable to take pictures, and most of all, I liked the atmosphere because it was the atmosphere I really liked.,,,

text: 평일 저녁이라서 얼마안기다리고 구매 할 수있었던거 같습니다.
text_en: Since it was a weekday evening, I think I was able to purchase it without waiting long.

text: 케이크도 맛있고 분위기도 너무너무 좋아요
text_en: The cake is delicious and the atmosphere is really nice.

text: 바삭한식감이 전혀없는 그냥 모닝빵식감에 축축하고 짜고 기름범벅… 분명 첨엔 이러지않았는데 단일메뉴이데도 아쉽다
text_en: It's just a morning bread texture without any crunchiness at all, wet, salty, and covered in oil... I definitely didn't do this the first time, but it's disappointing even though it's a single menu.

text: 에스프레소 좋아하시는 분들이라면 분명히 좋아할 가게입니다!!
text_en: If you like espresso, this is definitely a store you will love!!

text: 황치즈 푸딩은 제 취향은 아닌듯합니당
text_en: I don’t think yellow cheese pudding is my taste.

text: 카페가 조용하고 인테리어가 마음에 들어요
text_en: The cafe is quiet and I like the interior.

text: 카페 공간 자체도 깔끔하고 예뻐서 성수 오면 종종 들를 것 같아요~
text_en: The cafe space itself is clean and pretty, so I think I’ll stop by often when I come to Seongsu.

text: 🤍 배 셔벗에이드 시원해요오
text_en: 🤍 Pear sorbetade is refreshing!

text: 날씨가 좋아서 야외테이블 사용하였는데 너무 좋은 거 같아요
text_en: The weather was nice so we used an outdoor table and I think it was really nice.

text: 서울 놀러와서 성수 근처 갈 일 있으면 무조건 들렸던 자연도인데 이틀연속으로 너무 맛이 실망스러워서 이젠 안갈 거 같아요..
text_en: Whenever I come to Seoul and go near Seongsu, I always stop by Jayeondo Island, but the food was so disappointing for two days in a row that I don't think I'll go there anymore.

text: 주말에는 사람 많으니 자리 먼저 잡고 주문하셔야해요 리본 페스추리 구테 넛 슈페너 유자 버블 블루 유자 버블 블루는 음료 주문하고 픽업할 때 버블 올려주세요
text_en: There are a lot of people on weekends, so you have to grab a seat first and order. Ribbon Pastry, Goutte Nut, Schwanner, Yuzu Bubble Blue, please add the bubble when ordering drinks and picking them up.

text: 시간단위로 구워서 판매하는 마케팅을 쓰고 있지만 빵은 미지근(차가운쪽에 가까움) 했고, 버터 풍미도 크지 않았고, 텍스쳐도 쫄깃도 퍽퍽도 아닌 애매한 그 어딘가였어요
text_en: They are marketing the product by baking it and selling it by the hour, but the bread was lukewarm (closer to cold), the butter flavor wasn't great, and the texture was somewhere ambiguous, neither chewy nor dry.

text: 달달해서 쌉싸름한 맛이 덜 느껴짐
text_en: It's sweet so it doesn't taste bitter.

text: 소금빵 너무 맛있는곳!
text_en: Salt bread is so delicious!

text: 🥵 날씨만 좋았다면 더 분위기 좋은 야외로 나가고 싶습니다
text_en: 🥵 If the weather was nice, I would like to go outdoors in a better atmosphere.

text: 커피로 유명해서 들러봤는데 분위기도 좋고 직원분들도 친절해요!
text_en: I stopped by because it's famous for its coffee, and the atmosphere is nice and the staff are friendly!

text: 빵 자체를 별로 안 좋아해서 특별한 소금빵이 있을까 반신반의하면서 먹었는데, 겉은 살짝 빠삭하면서 속은 부드러워서 ?!?!
text_en: I don't really like bread itself, so I ate it wondering if there was a special salt bread, but it was slightly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside?!?!

text: 약간 느껴지는 후추향이 킥으로 오고, 줄줄 흐르는 꼬소한 버터맛에 감동.
text_en: The slightly peppery scent gives me a kick, and I am impressed by the subtle buttery taste.

text: 성수 다니면서 잘 쉬었습니다. (여행중)
text_en: I had a good rest while visiting Seongsu. (Traveling)

text: 🙂 차들도 모두 맛있고, 뷰도 너무 좋아서 기분좋게 책을 읽을 수 있었어요.
text_en: 🙂 All the teas were delicious, and the view was so nice that I was able to read the book comfortably.

text: 사람 너무 많고 음악이 시끄러워요 인테리어랑 진짜 안 어울리게 에스파 whiplash 같은거 빵빵하게 나오네여
text_en: There are too many people and the music is loud. It doesn't really match the interior, and there's a lot of Espa whiplash or something like that.

text: 다음에도 재방문 하고 싶습니다
text_en: I would like to visit again next time

text: 성수동 또 가면 들리고 싶네요
text_en: I want to stop by when I go to Seongsu-dong again.

text: 처음에 까눌레 하나씩 주는거 말고는 따로 같이나오는 마카롱도 이젠 없는거 같구요.
text_en: Other than the first canelé provided, I don't think there are any macaroons that come separately anymore.

text: 꽃집을 같이 하시는 건지 매장에 꽃이 가득해서 더 예쁘고 좋은 공간이었어요.
text_en: Perhaps because they run a flower shop together, the store was full of flowers, making it a prettier and nicer space.

text: 또 한개는 사촌언니남친오셔서 드렸당!
text_en: I gave another one to my cousin and her boyfriend when they came!

text: 소금빵유명해서 가본곳이에요
text_en: I went there because it was famous for salt bread.

text: 엔시티 드림이라는 그룹의 재민 생일이라서 갔능데 너무 좋아요!!
text_en: I went because it was Jaemin's birthday from a group called NCT Dream, and I loved it!!

text: 더티초코롤은 진한 초코맛이 매력적이었고, 롱블랙과 함께 먹으면 밸런스가 괜찮아 잘 어울렸습니다.
text_en: The dirty chocolate roll had an attractive rich chocolate flavor, and when eaten with long black, it was well balanced and went well together.

text: 겨울이라 따뜻한 블랙 밀크티 ~
text_en: Warm black milk tea because it’s winter~

text: 빵 너무너무 맛있고 커피도 합리적인가격이라 좋습니다!
text_en: The bread is so delicious and the coffee is reasonably priced too!

text: 김사홍바리스타님이 오신다고 해서 찾아왔는데요, 세트 음료가 다 특색 있고 맛있지만 그 중에 에스프레소가 정말 인상적이었습니다!
text_en: I came here because barista Kim Sahong was coming. The set drinks were all unique and delicious, but the espresso was really impressive!

text: 그건 둘째치고 주문받으신 저 직원분 솔직히 마음상했습니다.
text_en: Aside from that, I was honestly upset with the employee who took my order.

text: 가족여행으로 성수동에 왔는데 인테리어도 좋고 깨끗하고 빵이 맛있었어요 :)
text_en: I came to Seongsu-dong on a family trip, and the interior was nice and clean, and the bread was delicious :)

text: 편하게 얘기할 수 있고 성수동을 내려다볼 수 있는 통유리창이 있어서 시원시원하고 좋아요
text_en: It's nice and cool because you can talk comfortably and there's a full-length glass window that overlooks Seongsu-dong.

text: 받아서 대기줄에서 대기하다가 소금빵 받아가면 돼요!
text_en: All you have to do is wait in line and get the salt bread!

text: 한교동 생일카페로 방문했는데 매장도 넓고 깨끗하고 직원분들도 너무 친절하셔서 좋은 기억만 남았네요!
text_en: I visited the birthday cafe in Hangyo-dong, and the store was spacious and clean, and the staff were very friendly, so I only had good memories!

text: 매장이 깨끗하고 노래가 좋아요
text_en: The store is clean and the songs are good.

text: 품절된 물품이 재입고 되지 않는것부터 어이없었는데 그래서 있는 거라곤 키링 몇 개, 수저, 필터샤워기, 노트, 양말, 랜덤교동이가챠 19000원, 카드지갑인지 뭔지, 인형은 컵모양 딱 하나 남아있음.
text_en: It was ridiculous that sold out items were not restocked, so all I had were a few key rings, a spoon, a shower filter, a notebook, socks, a random Kyo-dong gacha worth 19,000 won, a card wallet or something, and there was only one doll left in the shape of a cup.

text: 분위기가 너무 좋아요.
text_en: I really like the atmosphere.

text: 뭐 이 시간대 오신 손님이 테이블을 두드리며 웃으실 만큼 시끄러우신 분이긴 했어요 .
text_en: Well, the customer who came at this time was so loud that he was banging on the table and laughing.

text: 다만 무조건 1세트(4개입)에 포장용기 아예 없구 줄 서서 기다리면서 먹을 만큼은 아닌 것 같아용
text_en: However, I don't think it's enough to eat while waiting in line because there is no packaging container for one set (4 pieces).

text: 붐비지 않아서 대화하기 좋습니다
text_en: It's not crowded so it's good for conversation

text_en: Because it was a weekday, I was able to get in right away, and I really liked the atmosphere.

text: 다른데 소금빵은 3,300원이나 3,800원도 많이 봤는데 하루 7,000개 파는 개 핫 유명한곳치고는 저렴한편이라 강츄
text_en: I've seen other salt breads cost 3,300 won or 3,800 won, but I highly recommend it because it's cheap for a famous place that sells 7,000 pieces a day.

text: 오리지널 마셨는데 너무 달지 않으면서 라이트한 맛이었어요~
text_en: I drank the original and it was light and not too sweet.

text: 본점에서 커피 오마카세를 정말 기분좋게 경험했던 기억이 있어 지인에게 소개해주려 방문하게 되었습니다.
text_en: I had a really pleasant experience with coffee omakase at the main branch, so I decided to visit to introduce it to a friend.

text: 카페가 넘쳐나는 성수에서도 실패없을 맛을 가진 곳:) 테이크아웃만되는 공간입니다용..
text_en: Even in Seongsu, which is overflowing with cafes, this is a place where you can't go wrong with delicious food :) This is a take-out only space.

text: 평일에는 그래도 10-15분 내로 받을 수 있는 것 같습니다
text_en: I think I can still get it within 10-15 minutes on weekdays.

text: 성수역에서 여기 카페가 그래도 한적하고 디저트도 많고 좋은 것 같아용!
text_en: I think this cafe in Seongsu Station is quiet, has a lot of desserts, and is good!

text: 점심을 많이 먹은 후 사서 바로 못먹고 오후 내 들고 다녔더니 깜찍한 봉지가 많이 구겨졌지만 그 안 소금빵은 안전했답니다
text_en: I bought it after a big lunch and couldn't eat it right away. I carried it around in the afternoon and the cute bag was very wrinkled, but the salt bread inside was safe.

text: 스테포스트 브라운라떼가 제일맛있구요 디저트중에선 치즈테린느가 진짜 맛있네요
text_en: The Steppost Brown Latte is the most delicious, and among the desserts, the cheese terrine is really delicious.

text: 버터향 그윽하고 넘나 맛나부려요!!
text_en: It smells like butter and is so delicious!!

text: 생일케익 구매하려고 방문했어요, 귀여운 초도 다양하고 파티할 소품도 있어 한번에 구매할 수 있어 좋은 것 같아요
text_en: I came here to buy a birthday cake. There are a variety of cute candles and party props, so it's nice to be able to buy them all at once.

text: 매장이 넓어서 주말인데 웨이팅 없이 들어와서 좋아요~!
text_en: The store is large, so it’s nice to be able to come in without waiting even on the weekend!

text: 카페에서 직접 마시지는 못했지만 잘 꾸며 놓았더라구요!

text_en: - Chewy, sweet and salty #Delicious taste #Dessert #Salt bread #Seongsu #Ttukseom #Bread

text_en: It was cold, but it was a great place to have a conversation with warm tea!

text_en: The space is spacious and fully equipped with outlets, which is nice.

text_en: Guteroite is always attractive with good music and spacious space!

text: 혼자 책읽기에도 좋고 둘이 조용히 대화하기 좋아 종종 들립니다.
text_en: It's great for reading alone and for two people to talk quietly, so I stop by often.

text: 바 형태의 좌석이 많아서 독서와 공부를 하거나 사색을 즐기는 등 혼자만의 시간을 가질 수 있는 힐링 공간이에요.
text_en: It is a healing space where you can have some alone time, such as reading, studying, or contemplating, as there are many bar-type seats.

text: 커피를 제대로 만드는 곳 같아서 와봤는데, 당충전 제대로 하고 가는것 같아요.
text_en: I came here because it seemed like a good place to make coffee, and I felt like I was properly recharged.

text: 그라니따로 정신 확 차리고 롱블랙으로 진정하니 코스 완성입니다
text_en: After coming to my senses with granita and calming down with long black, the course is complete.

text: 혼자 한개정도 먹어볼까 하고 줄섰는데 메뉴에 4개세트 한개만 선택할 수 있도록 되어있어 꽤 많이 당황했네요.
text_en: I lined up thinking I could try one by myself, but I was quite confused because the menu only allowed me to choose one set of four.

text: 테이크아웃 하려고 갔는데 보드게임 있어서 매장에서 마시고 왔어요
text_en: I went to get takeout, but there was a board game so I had a drink at the store.

text: 우연히 지나다 왔는데 핫플같애여 사람도많고 샤벳에쏘 맛있어용
text_en: I happened to pass by and it looks like a hot place. There are a lot of people and the sherbet is delicious.

text: 소금빵 픽업할때 주문번호 확인 후 주실 줄 알아서 기다렸는데, 확인도 안하시고 먼저 주실려고 해서 기다리는 입장에서 기분이 좋지 않았습니다.
text_en: When I picked up the salt bread, I thought they would give it to me after checking my order number, but they tried to give it to me first without even confirming it, so I didn't feel good waiting.

text: 조용하고 나만의 시간 보내기 최고
text_en: Best for quiet and alone time

text: 성수에 오면 꼭 먹어야 하는 자연도 소금빵 in 성수 무조건 먹어야지
text_en: When you come to Seongsu, you must eat natural salt bread in Seongsu.

text: 너무 와보고 싶었던 곳이였는데 와보니 생각했던 것 보다 너무 예뻐요
text_en: It was a place I really wanted to visit, but when I got there, it was prettier than I thought.

text: 원두 고소, 산미, 디카페인 선택가능 1층에 카페 자리 계속 만석 2층에는 편집솝 처럼 예쁜 옷들 판매 커다란 회전 문이 인상 깊은 가게에요
text_en: You can choose between savory, sour, and decaffeinated coffee beans. The cafe on the first floor is always full. On the second floor, pretty clothes like Edit Soap are sold. The large revolving door is an impressive store.

text: 지나가다 들른 커피바인데 커피 종류도 다양하더라도요 아아도 맛있고 내부 인테리어도 예뻐요
text_en: This is a coffee bar I stopped by while passing by, and although there are many different types of coffee, it's delicious and the interior is pretty.

text: 주문받는 직원분도 너무 친절하시구 뻔한 카페메뉴 말고 새로운 메뉴들이 많아 만족 스러웠어요 :) 매장은 작지만 적당한 소음과 테라스까지 아주 맘에 들었어요
text_en: The staff who took my order was very friendly and I was satisfied with the many new menu items other than the typical cafe menu :) Although the store is small, I really liked the reasonable noise level and the terrace.

text: 테이크아웃 전문이라 무더위에 앉아서 편히 먹을 곳이 없어 아쉬웠지만 길빵(?)해도 행복한 맛이었어요!
text_en: It was a shame that there was no place to sit and eat comfortably in the scorching heat since it was a takeout specialty, but even the long bread(?) was a happy experience!

text: 커피와 디저트 다 맛있어요 !
text_en: Both the coffee and desserts are delicious!

text: 입장 전 직원분이 기분 좋게 해주시고 다들 친절하셔서 좋았어요!
text_en: The staff made me feel good before entering and everyone was friendly, which was great!

text: 냄새의 유혹 줄이 짧아서 들려봤어요
text_en: Temptation of Smell I tried it because the line was short.

text: 분위기 좋고 공간도 넓으며 친구랑 얘기나누기도 좋은 분위기인듯 합니다
text_en: The atmosphere is nice, the space is spacious, and it seems like a good place to talk with friends.

text: 여기 커피가 맛있어서 종종 오는데 매장도 이쁘고 넓어서 좋습니다
text_en: I come here often because the coffee is delicious, and the store is pretty and spacious.

text: 지나가다 냄새 너무좋아서 사먹었는데 무조건 4개 세트만 파네요.
text_en: I bought it in passing because it smelled so good, but they only sold sets of 4.

text: 따뜻한 소금빵 그자리에서 바로 한입 먹는걸 추천!
text_en: I recommend eating a bite of the warm salt bread right on the spot!

text: 따뜻한 차를 마시며 야경까지 보고, 생각정리도 할 수 있는 곳이었어요~
text_en: It was a place where you could drink warm tea, watch the night view, and organize your thoughts.

text: 가득머금은 시럽이 넘쳐서 그건 참고해야하고, 복숭아 맛,향 사용된 크림도 삼박자가 어느하나 아쉬울게 없습니다:)
text_en: Please keep that in mind as the syrup is overflowing, and the cream used in the peach flavor and scent is all the same, so you won't be disappointed in any of it :)

text: 공차 너무 맛있어요, 요새 자주 먹는데 브래운슈가 밀크티에 치즈폼 조합 완전 강추입니당
text_en: Gongcha is so delicious, I've been eating it a lot lately, and I highly recommend the combination of brown sugar milk tea and cheese foam.

text: 야외 테이블 사이에 공간도 넓어서 시야도 트이고 답답하지 않아서 좋았어요.
text_en: It was nice that there was a lot of space between the outdoor tables, so the view was open and it wasn't stuffy.

text: 친구가 레드벨벳 케이크 좋아해서 준비해봤어요.
text_en: My friend likes red velvet cake, so I prepared it.

text: 갓 구운 소금빵이 나와서 그런지 바삭하고 맛있어요.
text_en: Perhaps because it comes from freshly baked salt bread, it is crispy and delicious.

text: 믿고 먹는 자연도소금빵!!
text_en: Natural salt bread that you can trust and eat!!

text: 빵도 맛있고 분위기도 좋구 좌석도 많고 넓어요!
text_en: The bread is delicious, the atmosphere is nice, and there are lots of seats and it’s spacious!

text: 식은 상태에서 먹었는데 부드러운 빵피와 고소짭짜름한 버터와 소금의 조화가 완벽해요.
text_en: I ate it while it was cold, and the combination of the soft crust, salty butter, and salt was perfect.

text: 오랜만에 콧바람 쐴 겸 당충전하려고 와봤어요
text_en: It's been a while since I came here to clear my throat and recharge.

text: 번잡스러운 분위기아니고 차분하고 조용한분위기라 자주 찾게될것같아요!
text_en: It's not a busy atmosphere, but a calm and quiet atmosphere, so I think I'll come here often!

text: 카페가 넓고 쾌적해서 대화 나누기 좋아요~
text_en: The cafe is spacious and comfortable, so it’s great for conversation~

text: 커피가 맛있고 힙해요
text_en: The coffee is delicious and hip.

text: 외곽에 놀러 온 듯한 한적한 느낌과 함께 공간도 넓고 심플 세련된 공간이에요.
text_en: It is a spacious, simple and sophisticated space with a quiet feeling as if you are visiting the outskirts.

text: 카운터 직원분도 바리스타분도 모두 친절하고 좋으셨어요.
text_en: The counter staff and barista were all friendly and nice.

text: 펄을 빼고 먹고 싶은 음료가 있어서 오더기기 앞에사 서성 거리니까 스탭분이 도와주셨어요.
text_en: There was a drink I wanted to drink without the pearls, so I lingered in front of the ordering machine and the staff helped me.

text: 고소한거 좋아하시는 분 구테 넛 슈페너 진짜 추천드려요 유자 버블 브루도 예쁜데 달콤쌉쌀해서 여자친구가 진짜 좋아했습니다
text_en: If you like savory foods, I really recommend the Gute Nut Spener. The Yuzu Bubble Brew is also pretty, but it's sweet and bitter, so my girlfriend really liked it.

text: 신상카페라그런지 손님도 아직 막붐비지않아 여유있어서 좋았어요.
text_en: Maybe it's because it's a new cafe, but it's not crowded yet, so it's nice to have some space.

text: 디저트는 오란다가 있는데 이것 또한 별미입니다만 가격이 조금 사악해요
text_en: Dessert is oranda, which is also a delicacy, but the price is a bit steep.

text: 야외에 앉기 멋진곳 커피는 비싼편 맛은 소소
text_en: Nice place to sit outside. Coffee is expensive but taste is small.

text: 힙한 성수에서 힙한 믹스커피를 마실 수 있다니 힙한 사람이 된 것만 같네요
text_en: Being able to drink hip mixed coffee in hip Seongsu makes me feel like a hip person.

text: 도심 속에서 맛있고 따뜻한 차를 마시고 싶을 땐 맥파이앤타이거 강추요!!
text_en: If you want to drink delicious, warm tea in the city, I highly recommend Magpie & Tiger!!

text: 인상적인건 에스프레소 추출시 설탕도 함께 추출하는 방식을 취한다는데, 산미랑 단맛이 함께 있네요.
text_en: What's impressive is that when extracting espresso, sugar is also extracted, so it has both acidity and sweetness.

text: 주말에 푹 쉬다가 집근처 카페 찾아서 왔는데,, 너무 좋아서 쿠폰 찍어갑니다 !
text_en: After a good rest on the weekend, I found a cafe near my house and I liked it so much that I took a coupon!

text: 커피맛도 좋지만 빵이 정말 맛있어요!
text_en: The coffee tastes good, but the bread is really delicious!

text: 단짠단짠한 밀크폼은 맛있다.
text_en: The sweet and salty milk foam is delicious.

text: 인테리어가 좋아서 들어오자마자 기분이 좋았는데, 커피가 너무 맛있어요!
text_en: I felt good as soon as I came in because the interior was nice, and the coffee was so delicious!

text: 굳이 빵4개를 구입하게 만드는 마케팅도 대단하다 결국 두개는 남겼다
text_en: The marketing was so great that it made me buy 4 loaves of bread. In the end, I ended up with two left over.

text: 4개에 12000원으로 팔아요~
text_en: Selling for 12,000 won for 4 pieces.

text: 💜 기다림은 힘들었지만 덕분에 넘 행복한 정국절💜💜
text_en: 💜 The waiting was hard, but thanks to you, I had a very happy Jeongguk Day💜💜

text: 대박적👍 비엔나 커피의 크림 너무 맛난데 커피의 산미가 내겐 별루, 라떼는 차라리 부드러워 괜찮았다.
text_en: Awesome👍 The cream of the Vienna coffee was very delicious, but the acidity of the coffee was not good for me, and the latte was softer and better.

text: 너무 좋아하는 소금빵!
text_en: I love salt bread so much!

text: 성수에 약속이 있어서 왔다가 소금빵 맛있는 곳이 있다고해서 첫번째로 들렀는데 😎 웨이팅은 줄서서 10분 정도 했고요
text_en: I had an appointment in Seongsu, so I stopped by first because I heard there was a place with delicious salt bread. 😎 The wait in line was about 10 minutes.

text: 그만큼 인테리어가 사진 찍기 너무 좋았어요.
text_en: The interior was so nice to take pictures of.

text: 으헤 너무 쾌적하고 친절하고 맛있어요
text_en: Ugh, it’s so comfortable, friendly, and delicious.

text: 바로 먹었을때 빵에 부드러움에 놀랐고 맛이 진짜 조화로워서 놀랐는데 다음날 먹어도 굳지 않고 더 말랑해진 느낌.
text_en: When I ate it right away, I was surprised by the softness of the bread and the harmony of flavors, but when I ate it the next day, it felt softer and not hardened.

text: 배경음악도 경쾌한 팝이 흘러나오는데 고전적인 인테리어랑 약간 미스매칭되는 느낌.
text_en: The background music is also lively pop, but it feels a bit mismatched with the classic interior.

text: 성수동 갔다가 소금빵집 있길래 찾아갔더니 길에 사람들이 줄을 서 있더군요.
text_en: When I went to Seongsu-dong, I saw a salt bakery and went to see it. There were people lining up on the street.

text: 무조건 4개들입 한박스씩 주문가능해요
text_en: You can order one box of 4 each.

text: 바삭한 겉면과 쫀득한 속이 조화를 이루고, 짭조름한 소금 맛이 은은하게 퍼지면서 담백함이 살아 있어 정말 만족스러웠습니다.
text_en: I was very satisfied with the combination of the crispy exterior and the chewy interior, and the subtle salty taste that kept it light.

text: 조명과 가구, 좌석 배치, 음악 등의 조화로 매장 내부 전반적인 분위기가 감성적이에요.
text_en: The overall atmosphere inside the store is emotional due to the harmony of lighting, furniture, seating arrangements, and music.

text: 먹다 들어갔는지 모르겠다 하셨는데 저 정도 다리의 벌레를 몰랐을리는 없고 개인적으로 얼음에 붙어 있던 것 같음
text_en: He said he didn't know if he had eaten something, but there's no way he wouldn't have known about the bug on his leg. Personally, I think it was stuck to the ice.

text: 성수 말고 다른 곳에도 지점이 있는 에스프레소 바 가장 기본 구테로이테 에스프레소를 시켜보았는데 위에 올라간 크럼블이 달달해서 에스프레소를 잘 먹지 못해도 맛있게 먹을 수 있습니다
text_en: This is an espresso bar that has branches in places other than Seongsu. I ordered the most basic Guteroite espresso, and the crumbles on top were sweet, so even if you don't usually drink espresso, you can still enjoy it.

text: 이거파는곳 별로없어서커피 좋아하시는 분들께 추천합니다!
text_en: There aren't many places that sell this, so I recommend it to people who like coffee!

text: 세트로만 판매하는 곳이고 키오스크 주문 후 대기해주시면 소금빵 받아보실 수 있어요
text_en: This is a place that only sells sets, and you can receive salt bread by waiting at the kiosk after ordering.

text: 어마어마한 소금빵맛집,,,🤍 웨이팅이 엄청 길어서 항상 빵냄새만 맡고왔었는데 오늘은 운좋게 대기없이 구입할 수 있었어용
text_en: A great salt bread restaurant,,,🤍 The wait was so long that I could always smell the bread, but today I was lucky enough to buy it without waiting.

text: 근데 하루 지나기 전에 다먹긴 해요..
text_en: But I eat it all before the day goes by.

text: 🧡 포장도 너무 귀엽고 판매하시는 분들 복장 귀염귀염🎈소금빵 파는 곳 여러 군데 먹어봤지만 나름 이곳에 줄서는 이유 알 것 같아요
text_en: 🧡 The packaging is so cute and the people selling it are cute 🎈 I've tried several places that sell salt bread, but I think I understand why there's a line here.

text: 우연히 근처에 카페 찾아서 들어왔는데 너무너무 기분 좋고 만족하는 카페였어요
text_en: I happened to find a cafe nearby and came in, and it was a very pleasant and satisfying cafe.

text: 구테로이테 커피 맛집인데 왜 케잌도 맛있고 빵도 맛있는거에요?!!
text_en: Gutteroite is a great coffee restaurant, but why is the cake and bread so delicious?!!

text: 차는 말씀드리면 한 번 더 우려주셔요
text_en: When I tell you about the tea, please brew it one more time.

text: 으아💛 소금빵 마이 좋아해서 어떤빵집가도 소금빵 주문은 디폴트라 여기저기꺼 먹어본 전데 자연도께 소프트 소금빵중에선 일등이네요!!
text_en: Ugh💛 I love salt bread, so no matter what bakery I go to, I default to ordering salt bread. I've tried a lot of them here and there, but this is the best among soft salt breads at Jayeondo!!

text: 마케팅은 승리 - 소금빵에 기대하는 그런 맛은 전혀 없다 -
text_en: Marketing is a win - it doesn't have the flavor you'd expect from salt bread - at all.

text: 키오스크 도입 후 정해진 수량을 시간대별로 포장 후 판매하는 형태로 운영 방식을 바꿔서인지, 오늘 대기인원이 2명뿐 드디어 샀다!
text_en: Perhaps because they changed their operating method after introducing kiosks to packaging and selling a set quantity by time slot, there were only two people waiting today and I finally bought it!

text: 🩶 높은 고층에서 바라보는 뷰, 탁 트인 키친(?)
text_en: 🩶 View from a high floor, open kitchen(?)

text: 친구와 간만에 만나 담소도 나누고 분위기 있는 곳에서 멋진 하루의 시작이 되서 너무 좋았네요.
text_en: It was great to meet up with a friend for the first time in a while, chat with them, and start a wonderful day in a place with a great atmosphere.

text: 항상 줄서서 먹는 자연도 소금빵을 사먹어봤어요.
text_en: I also bought the salt bread that people always line up to eat.

In particular, Henry's Plat's Semla is characterized by the addition of apple mango, adding a refreshing and sweet taste and texture.

According to the review, there is nothing special if you take it home and it tastes good only if you eat it right away, so I only ordered the food to eat right away. It was delicious, but I don't know if it tastes better than other places;; The packaging is pretty, but it feels like the line is getting longer, so for people like us who want to eat right away, we unwrap it as soon as we receive it;; You could just ask and have them give you the whole bag.

text: 갠적으로 저는 말차맛이 더 맛있었어요
