text: 음료도 맛있고 근데 19시 이후에 베이크류 할인한다고 써있었는데 영수증보니 할인이 안되어있네요
text_en: The drinks were delicious, but it said there was a discount on baked goods after 19:00, but when I looked at the receipt, there was no discount.

text: 키리모찌를 구워먹을 수 있고 생각보다 떡을 많이 주셔서 배부르게 먹었어요
text_en: I was able to grill and eat Kirimochi, and they gave me more rice cakes than I expected, so I ate it to my fill.

text: 지나가다가 분위기가 너무 이뻐서 들렀는데 생각했던것보다 너무 모든게 다 좋아서 성수오게되면 또 여기 올 것 같아요!
text_en: I was passing by and stopped by because the atmosphere was so pretty, but everything was so much better than I expected, so I think I'll come here again when I come to Seongsu!

text: 성수동 소금빵 맛집 테이크아웃 전용이라 키오스크로 구매 후 빵 받는줄에 서야해요
text_en: The salt bread restaurant in Seongsu-dong is for takeout only, so you have to buy it at the kiosk and then stand in line to receive the bread.

text: 중간중간 깨알 소품 찾아보는 재미도 있었고 요번 HAPPY 테마로 소다맛 음료까지 준비해주셔서 맛있게 잘 마시고 가용
text_en: It was fun to look for small items here and there, and they even prepared a soda-flavored drink with the HAPPY theme this time, so I had a good time drinking it.

text: 갓구운 빵 먹으니 더 맛잇엇어요!
text_en: It tasted even better when I ate freshly baked bread!

text: 성수에 너무 북적이지않은 조용한곳에 새로생긴 대형카페가 있다고해서 가봤는데 입구부터 커다란 크리스마스트리가 너무 이쁘더라구요!
text_en: I heard there was a new large cafe in a quiet place in Seongsu that wasn't too crowded, so I went there and the big Christmas tree right from the entrance was so pretty!

text: 포장도 감성있고, 가게도 감성있는 게 충전되네요.
text_en: The packaging is emotional, and the store is also filled with emotion.

text: 🥐 저녁 8시반쯤 갔는데 15-20분 밖에 안 걸렸어요!
text_en: 🥐 I went around 8:30 pm and it only took 15-20 minutes!

text: 말차 테린느 개맛도리고 디저트가 친절하고 카페가 맛있습니다.
text_en: The matcha terrine is delicious, the desserts are friendly, and the cafe is delicious.

text: 디저트 맛집인데 아파서 차만 마신 내 자신 슬퍼요
text_en: It's a great dessert restaurant, but I'm sad that I only drank tea because I was sick.

text: 🎄💕 자리도 1층이랑 2층 있는데 자리 간격도 안좁아서 친구들이랑 얘기하기도 괜찮고 데이트로 가는것도 추천합니다
text_en: 🎄💕 There are seats on the 1st and 2nd floors, and the space between the seats is not too tight, so it's good to talk with friends, and I recommend going on a date.

text: 바로 구입해서 먹으면 또 구입하겠지만 웨이팅하면서 또 구매할지는 ;;
text_en: I will buy it again if I eat it right away, but will I buy it again while waiting?;;

text: 리뷰에 쏘쏘하다는 말이 많았지만 저는 개인적으로 너무 맛있게 먹었어요~
text_en: A lot of reviews said it was spicy, but I personally really enjoyed it.

text: 콘센트도 있고 조용해서 좋아요
text_en: It's nice that there's an outlet and it's quiet.

text: 동네에 강아지 동반 카페는 많아도 강아지가 앉아있기 불편한 곳들이 많은데 여기는 강아지도 편하게 앉아있을 수 있어서 좋아요!!
text_en: Although there are many dog-friendly cafes in the neighborhood, there are many places where dogs are uncomfortable to sit, but this is great because even dogs can sit comfortably!!

text: 커피가 맛난집 재방문 지난번엔 에스프레소를 마시고 오늘은 케잌까지 포인트적립 하면 텀블러까지 성수의 맛깔나는 까페
text_en: Revisiting a place with delicious coffee. Last time I had espresso, today I even got a cake. If I accumulate points, I even get a tumbler. A delicious cafe in Seongsu.

text: 분위기 조용하고 좋아요
text_en: The atmosphere is quiet and nice

text: 지나가다가 사람들 많아서 들어왔는데 분위기도 좋고커피도 맛있어요
text_en: I was passing by and came in because there were a lot of people. The atmosphere was nice and the coffee was delicious.

text: 에스프레소를 즐길 수 있고 그 외의 다른 음료와 디저트들을 즐길 수 있어요
text_en: You can enjoy espresso and other drinks and desserts.

text: 진짜진짜루 다른 소금빵은 퍼석한게 많은데 여긴 진짜 쫄깃하고 부드럽고 정말 은은하게 달짝지근하면서 짭쪼롬해서 계속 들어가요
text_en: Really, a lot of other salt breads are crumbly, but this one is really chewy, soft, and very subtly sweet and salty, so I keep eating it.

text: 단, 낱개 판매도 하면 좋겠어요!
text_en: However, it would be nice if they sold them individually too!

text: 보이숙차랑 현미목련차, 말차&팥 치즈케잌까지 맛있게 먹고 갑니다!
text_en: I enjoyed the Boisuk tea, brown rice magnolia tea, matcha & red bean cheesecake!

text: 주말 오전에 방문했는데 한적하고 빵 종류도 많고 케이크류도 있어요.
text_en: I visited on a weekend morning, and it was quiet and had a variety of breads and cakes.

text: 분위기도 좋구요~~
text_en: The atmosphere is good too~~

text: 귀여운 벌룬과 멋진 석진오빠로 가득한 곳 커피도 맛있고 깔끔한 인테리어로 예쁜 성수 비데이 담에도 또 올거에요~~
text_en: It's a place full of cute balloons and the cool Seokjin oppa. The coffee is delicious and the interior is pretty. I'll come again next time on Seongsu Bday~~

text: 원두 선택할 수 있고 주차비 저렴한 편 일요일 한시반쯤 들어갔는데 3시쯤 내/외부 좌석 거의 다 찼어요
text_en: You can choose your coffee beans and parking is cheap. I went in around 1:30 on a Sunday, and by 3, most of the inside and outside seats were full.

text: 공간도 엄청 넓고 깨끗해요~
text_en: The space is very spacious and clean.

text: 다른 메뉴의 에스프레소도 궁금하다 성수의 ☕️ 매장 넓고 꽤적하다 테이블아래 충전기 꼳을 수 있어서 갠ㅣ적으론 자주 올 거같다 ㄱ
text_en: I'm curious about the other menu's espressos. Seongsu's ☕️ store is spacious and quite quiet. You can turn on the charger under the table, so I think I'll come here often.

text: 😍 번으로 만든 디저트, 스콘, 휘낭시에 진짜 넘 맛있구요 포토존도 많아서 여기저기 사진찍어도 넘 예쁘게 나와요~
text_en: 😍 Desserts made with buns, scones, and financiers are really delicious. There are a lot of photo zones, so you can take pictures here and there and they come out really pretty~

text: 티백과 다도 도구 등 굿즈를 파는 공간도 있어서 이색적이고, 직원분들이 친절하셔서 머무르는 내내 마음이 편안해요!
text_en: There is also a unique space selling goods such as tea bags and tea ceremony tools, and the friendly staff makes you feel comfortable throughout your stay!

text: 거의 두달만에 왔는데 음악 여전하네요..
text_en: It's been almost two months since I came here, but the music is still the same...

text: 프랑스 맛있는빵을 열어서 맛있는 버터를 한가득넣고 입에 넣은 느낌 🥯🍞🥖🥐🥪🫓 외국인 관광객들도 좋아하시더라고요
text_en: The feeling of opening a delicious French bread and putting it in your mouth full of delicious butter 🥯🍞🥖🥐🥪🫓 Foreign tourists also like it.

text: 매장식사는 불가하고 포장만가능해서 줄이길어도 금방금방줄어듭니다.
text_en: In-store dining is not possible and only take-out is available, so even if the line is long, it goes down quickly.

text: 사자마자 먹어야만 제대로 느낄수있지만 포장해가도 에어프라이어로 소금빵을 심폐소생해 먹으면 바로 갓구운 소금빵맛을 느낄수있었습니다.
text_en: You can only really taste it if you eat it as soon as you buy it, but even if you take it out and resuscitate the salt bread in an air fryer, you can immediately feel the taste of freshly baked salt bread.

text: 분위기 너무좋고 차도 맛있어요
text_en: The atmosphere is very nice and the tea is delicious.

text: 사장님이 너무 친절하시고 분위기가 좋고 요즘 날씨가 너무 좋아서 테라스자리가 있는게 너무 좋았어용
text_en: The owner was very kind, the atmosphere was nice, and the weather was so nice these days, so I really liked having a terrace seat.

text: 영종도 지점보단 사알짝 맛이 약하긴 한데 그래도 믿고 먹는 자연도 소금빵 ❤️ 웬만한 베이커리 보다는 훠얼씬 맛나요!
text_en: The taste is slightly weaker than the Yeongjongdo branch, but I still trust the natural salt bread I eat ❤️ It tastes so much better than most bakeries!

text: 디저트로 먹으려고 했는데 낱개로는 안 팔아서 세트로 구매했어요!
text_en: I wanted to eat it as dessert, but they didn't sell it individually, so I bought it as a set!

text: 그래서 뭔진 모르지만 알겠다 했는데 엄청 작은 잔에 얼음없이 미지근한 라떼에 당황 이곳만의 스타일 이겠지만..;;
text_en: So, I didn't know what it was, but I said I knew, but I was taken aback by the lukewarm latte without ice in a very small glass. I guess it's just this place's style, but..;;

text: 파묘 팝업 대기하면서 더워 죽을꺼 같아서 마신 커피 맛나다.
text_en: I drank the coffee while waiting for the Pamyo pop-up, thinking I was going to die from the heat, and it was delicious.

text: 지나가는 길에 보여서 들어갔는데 적당히 소란하고 분위기 좋아요.
text_en: I saw it while passing by, so I went in, and it was moderately noisy and had a nice atmosphere.

text: 브런치로 프렌치토스트 + 수프+ 아멜카노 조합 환상적!
text_en: The combination of French toast + soup + Amelcano for brunch is fantastic!

text: 💚 핫여름이라 조금만 밖에 돌아댕겨도 더워서 힘이 빠지는데 맥파이앤타이거에서 시원한 차를 마시니까 기력이 보충되고 힐링이 되더라구요~
text_en: 💚 It's a hot summer, so even if I go outside for a little bit, I feel tired from the heat, but drinking cool tea at Magpie & Tiger replenishes my energy and gives me healing~

text: 했는데 계속 생각나고 다른데랑 비교했을때 정말 맛있어요~
text_en: I kept thinking about it and it was really delicious compared to other places.

text: 신사에 있는 곳은 시간이 안 맞아서 못 갔는데 성수에도 있다니 기뻐요 성수 시티뷰 창도 있고 중정 창도 있어서 비오는 날 방문하니 더 좋네요
text_en: I couldn't go to the one in the shrine because I didn't have the right time, but I'm glad that there's one in Seongsu. It has a Seongsu city view window and a courtyard window, so it's even better to visit on a rainy day.

text: It was nice to drink tea quietly. The city view was great and the tea was delicious. 👍 👍 👍
text_en: It was nice to drink tea quietly. The city view was great and the tea was delicious. 👍 👍 👍

text: 친구한테도 선물해줬어요
text_en: I also gave it to a friend as a gift.

text: 압구정이나 성수가면 꼭 사는 소금빵이에요!
text_en: Salt bread is a must-buy if you go to Apgujeong or Seongsu!

text: 귀여운 복장으로 특색있는 곳, 소금빵 단일 메뉴로 키오스크에서 주문하려면 줄, 후에 픽업 줄을 또 서야 해서 일행이 있으면 나눠 서는 게 빨리 받는 방법이에요
text_en: A unique place with cute outfits. Salt bread is a single menu item. If you want to order at the kiosk, you have to stand in line and then in line for pick-up, so if you're with a group, splitting up is the best way to get it quickly.

text: 맛있어서 또 대기할 의향 있어요(30분까지만)
text_en: It's so delicious that I'm willing to wait again (up to 30 minutes)

text: 하며 기다린지20분이 지날때쯤 반죽이 잘못됐다며 10분을 더 기다려야한대서 1차 기운이 빠졌고 10분후에 받기 직전, 빵이 없다고 죄송하다며 15분을 더 기다려야한다고 말을하는데 정말 화가났습니다.
text_en: After 20 minutes of waiting, they said that the dough was wrong and that I had to wait another 10 minutes, which made me lose my energy. Just before I received it 10 minutes later, they said that they were sorry that there was no bread and that I had to wait another 15 minutes, which made me really angry.

text: 빵 종류가 다양해서 배고플때 와도 좋구, 음료 종류도 다양해서 골라마실수있어 좋아요!
text_en: There are a variety of breads so you can come when you're hungry, and there are a variety of drinks to choose from!

text: 따뜻한 날 시원한 음료 마시면서 쉬고 싶어서 왔는데 분위기 완전 좋아여
text_en: I came here because I wanted to relax while drinking a cool drink on a warm day, and the atmosphere was really nice.

text: 콘센트가 있어서 좋어요.
text_en: It's nice to have an outlet.

text: 👍🏻👍🏻 슬러시 오리지널은 딱 믹스커피를 슬러시로 만든, 시원달달한 맛 !!
text_en: 👍🏻👍🏻 Slush Original is a refreshing and sweet taste made by mixing coffee into slush!!

text: 한입 먹는 순간~와 고소하고 맛있어요
text_en: The moment you take a bite, it’s savory and delicious.

text: 이거먹고 다른곳을 먹지를 못해요… 진짜 금빙 나온거먹으면 겉바속촉의 끝판왕 그리고 더해지는 버터향과 소금의 짭쪼롬함 자연도 가격도 저렴하고!
text_en: I can't eat anywhere else after eating this... If you eat real gold ice, it's the best of both worlds on the outside and the inside, plus the added buttery scent and salty taste of salt. It's natural and affordable!

text: 다만 주말이라 사람이 너무 많았고 내부가 매우 혼잡해서인지 설명해주시는 바리스타분 마저도 여유없이 바빠보이셨습니다.
text_en: However, because it was the weekend, there were too many people and the interior was very crowded, so even the barista who explained things seemed very busy.

text: 성수에 생겨서 다녀왔어요!
text_en: I went there because it was in Seongsu!

text: 매 계절마다 다른 메뉴로 운영되고 매월 운영되는 시간이 다른 만큼 예약이 필요한데, 예약하고 방문한 만큼 정말 기억에 남았던 것 같아요.
text_en: Reservations are required as the menu is different every season and the operating hours are different each month, but I think it was really memorable as I made a reservation and visited.

text: 스콘, 휘낭시에, 번 등 디저트가 다양한데다 셈라라는 특이한 디저트가 있어서 이것도 먹어봤어요!
text_en: There are a variety of desserts such as scones, financiers, and buns, and there is a unique dessert called Semla, so I tried that too!

text: 성수동에서 조용하고 잔잔한 분위기의 티카페가 없어서 아쉬웟었는데 요런데가 있는줄 몰랐네요
text_en: I was disappointed that there wasn't a tea cafe with a quiet and calm atmosphere in Seongsu-dong, but I didn't know there was a place like this.

text: 분위기도 좋고 커피도 너무 맛있고, 수박주스를 생수박 직접 갈아서 주시는것 보고 영업에 진심이시다 느꼈습니다!
text_en: The atmosphere was nice, the coffee was delicious, and I felt like they were sincere in their business when I saw that they grind the watermelon juice directly from fresh watermelon!

text: 다만 인스타갬성의 의자와 테이블 높이가 같은 좌석이 메인이라 다른자리 이용하긴했어요
text_en: However, the main seat was the same height as the Instagram chair and the table, so I used a different seat.

text: 낱개로판매는 아예 안하더라고요.
text_en: They don't sell them individually at all.

text: 사실 달달한 믹스커피에 밤이나 녹차맛이 좀 첨가된 맛일거라고 생각했는데 예상보다 많이 달지 않고 폼이 엄청 부드러워서 깜짝 놀랐고..
text_en: Actually, I thought it would be a sweet mixed coffee with some chestnut or green tea flavor added, but I was surprised that it wasn't as sweet as I expected and the foam was very soft.

text: Delicious desserts and drinks. Affordable price. Cozy place to hangout. Very recommended 🫶🫶😊😊
text_en: Delicious desserts and drinks. Affordable price. Cozy place to hangout. Very recommended 🫶🫶😊😊

text: 초를 꽂고 찍지 못해 아쉽지만 성수동 케이크 맛집 인정이에요!!
text_en: It's a shame I couldn't take a picture with the candles on, but this is recognized as a great cake restaurant in Seongsu-dong!!

text: 인테리어도 깔끔해서 팝업스토어 돌아다니다가 쉬기 좋아요
text_en: The interior is clean, so it’s great to take a break after wandering around the pop-up store.

text: 사진이 잘 나오고 직원들이 친절해요
text_en: The photos come out well and the staff is friendly.

text: 굽자마자 나와서 따뜻하게 먹었는데 빵 밑부분은 바삭하니 정말 맛있네요
text_en: It came out right after baking and I ate it warm. The bottom of the bread was crispy and it was really delicious.

text: 얼그레이한가득~~친절하시고넓고 다만 주차가안됨
text_en: Full of Earl Gray~~Friendly and spacious, but no parking

text: 매번 시간이 없어서 앉았다가질 못하고 테이크아웃만 하는데 눈이 번쩍!
text_en: Every time I don't have time, I can't sit down and just take out, but my eyes light up!

text: 맛있는 커피와 소금빵으로 당충전 하고 카페인 가득 채우고 다정한 데이트 하였습니다.
text_en: We recharged ourselves with delicious coffee and salt bread, filled ourselves up with caffeine, and had a friendly date.

text: 매장이 시끄러워서 차를 마시면서 집중하기엔 좋지 않아 비추함.
text_en: The store is noisy so it's not good for concentrating while drinking tea.

text: 테이블은 실버색 금속이며 철재 프레임의 투명한 의자가 준비되어 있습니다.
text_en: The table is made of silver metal and has transparent chairs with a steel frame.

text: 디저트 너무 맛있었어요
text_en: Dessert was so delicious

text: 제가 갔을 땐 4개 세트?
text_en: When I went, there were 4 sets?

text: 차를 즐기기 좋은 곳.
text_en: A great place to enjoy tea.

text: 성수동 돌아다니다가 검색없이 들어왔는데 카페 분위기가 너무 좋아요.
text_en: I came in without searching while wandering around Seongsu-dong, and I really like the atmosphere of the cafe.

text: 맨날집근처에서 시켜먹었던 구테로이떼… 그라니따 진짜 신의메뉴에요
text_en: A bunch of guterois that I always ordered near my house... Granita is truly a divine menu.

text: 고층에 도심속 차분한 노래가 흘러나와 조용하고 집중할수있는 분위기가 넘 좋았어요.
text_en: It was great to have a quiet and focused atmosphere with soothing songs playing in the city on a high floor.

text: 한강 피크닉 하느라 테이크아웃 했는데, 매장 내부 분위기가 좋아서 날이 좀 추워지면 먹고 가도 좋을 것 같아요!
text_en: I got takeout while having a picnic at the Han River, but the atmosphere inside the store is nice, so I think it would be nice to eat in when the weather gets a little colder!

text: 차 라는 걸 마시러 가는 경험 자체가 특별한데 공간도조용하고 좋았습니다
text_en: The experience of going to drink tea itself was special, and the space was quiet and nice.

text: 아 역시 다들 이렇게 줄서서 먹는 이유가 있었네요..
text_en: Ah, there was a reason why everyone lined up like this to eat.

text: 1층 2층까지 자리가 있어서 넓고 인테리어도 너무 마음에쏙!
text_en: It's spacious with seating from the first to the second floor, and I really like the interior!

text: 에스프레소 종류도 다양한데 가격이 카페인 잘 드시는 분이라면 호기심에 여러가지 마셔볼 수 있을만큼 합리적이에요.
text_en: There are many different types of espresso, and the prices are reasonable enough for those who like caffeine to try a variety out of curiosity.

text: 🥐✨ 구테로이테의 크루아상과 케이크는 역시나 기대를 저버리지 않는 맛이었어요.
text_en: 🥐✨ As expected, Guteroite's croissants and cakes did not disappoint.

text: 그래서 기회다 싶어서 한두개나 먹어보자 했습니다.
text_en: So I thought it was an opportunity and decided to try one or two.

text: 떵개랑 데이트, 떵개 대접받는날 멍푸치노 가성비 최고😭 아메도 맛있음
text_en: A date with a dog, a day when the dog is treated well, Mongpuccino is the best value for money😭 Ame is also delicious

text: 음악도 그렇고 사장님 열성적으로 일하시는 모습이 인상적이었어요.
text_en: I was impressed by the music and the passion the owner worked with.

text: 시트러스와 커피의 조화를 좋아하는 데도, 여기 그라니따는 그저 달고 새큼해서 밸런스가 별롭니다.
text_en: Even though I like the combination of citrus and coffee, the granita here is just sweet and sour, so the balance isn't great.

text: 느낌좋은 카페라고 저장했었다가 드디어 오게되었는데 기대이상으로 너무 좋아요
text_en: I saved it as a cafe with a nice feel and finally came here, and it was so much better than I expected.

text: 다만 줄서는 동선이 비효율적으로 보이네요
text_en: However, the queue line seems inefficient.

text: 빵에 기름이 좔좔 버터 가득이리 맛이 없을 수가 없네요
text_en: The bread is so oily and full of butter that it can't help but be delicious.

text: 가격은 사실 사악하지만 너무 이쁜 미디어 아트와 함께 조용히 대화할 수 있는 공간, 내가 특별해진 느낌 잘 느끼고 왔습니다 ◡̈
text_en: The price is actually outrageous, but I felt special in a space where I could have a quiet conversation with very pretty media art ◡̈

text: 빵은 좋은 재료를 썼다는 점을 많이 강조하고 실제로도 풍미가 좋습니다만 겉바속쫀한 소금빵을 좋아하는 입장에서 너무 부드러워서 좀 아쉬운 측면이 있었습니다.
text_en: There is a lot of emphasis on using good ingredients for the bread, and it actually has a good flavor, but as someone who likes chewy salt bread, it was a bit disappointing because it was too soft.

text: 성수빵맛집 자연도소금빵 성수 올때마다 줄이 길어서 포기했으나 오늘은 도전~ 10분정도 기다려서 소금빵주문 따뜻해서 더 맛있네
text_en: Seongsu Bread Restaurant, Jayeondo Salt Bread Every time I come to Seongsu, the line is long, so I give up, but today I give it a try. I wait for about 10 minutes to order salt bread. It's warm and tastes even better.

text: 예전 롯데백화점에서 알고 나서 성수동에 있길래 반가워 들어왔더니 완전 깔끔하고 멋진 인테리어에 직원분이 어찌나 친절한지 기분 좋더라구요
text_en: I found out about it from my old Lotte Department Store, and since it was in Seongsu-dong, I was happy to come in and was pleasantly surprised by the very clean and nice interior and the friendly staff.

text: 일단 프렌치 토스트 넘무 맛있고 라임 배 에이드였나 청량감 대박이에요!
text_en: First of all, the French toast is so delicious and the lime pear ade is super refreshing!

text: 평일 낮에 대기 없이 바로 주문했고 주문하면 바로 빵 포장해서 주시는데, 포장이 예뻐서 일단 마음에 들었습니다.
text_en: I ordered right away during the day on a weekday without waiting, and they packaged the bread right after I ordered. I liked the packaging because it was pretty.

text: 2층까지 테이블도 많아 자리도 충분하고 눈길닿는 구석구성 눈호강이에요
text_en: There are many tables up to the second floor, so there is plenty of seating, and the corner structure is eye-catching.

text: 소금빵 포장도 이뿌고 결재를 먼저 한뒤에 줄을 서야 하는 시스템이더라구요!
text_en: The packaging of the salt bread was pretty and there was a system where you had to pay first and then stand in line!

text: 친구가 좋아하는 곳이라고해서 처음 와봤는데 넓어서 앉을 곳도 많고 스페셜 메뉴도 많아서 또 오고 싶은 곳이에요~
text_en: I came here for the first time because my friend said it was his favorite place, but it's spacious so there's a lot of places to sit and there's a lot of special menus, so I want to come back again.

text: 🍵 혼자만의 시간을 보내면서 차 한잔 하시는 분들이 반 정도 되는 듯 했어요.
text_en: 🍵 It seemed like about half of the people were enjoying a cup of tea while spending time alone.

text: 낮과 밤 분위기가 달라 나름의 매력이 있어요 :) 따뜻한 차는 여느 티룸처럼 여러 번 우릴 수 있게 따뜻한 물 가져다 주세요.
text_en: The atmosphere is different during the day and at night, so it has its own charm :) Just like any other tea room, please bring me warm water so I can brew it several times.

text: 음악도 좋구 편안한 분위기에 사장님도 친절하시고 올때마다 기분좋아지는 공간이에요!!
text_en: The music is good, the atmosphere is comfortable, the owner is friendly, and it's a place that makes me feel good every time I come!!

text: 매장이 독특하고 느낌이 있어요.
text_en: The store has a unique and unique feel.

text: 딸기코코에이드도 공차처럼 씹히는 토핑이 있는데 상큼 달달하니 너무 달지 않아서 좋아요
text_en: Strawberry Cocoade also has a chewy topping like Gongcha, but it's refreshing and sweet, so I like it because it's not too sweet.

text: 저희는 두사람이 와서 음료 4개 주문했어요.
text_en: Two people came and ordered 4 drinks.

text: 항상 2잔 마시고 갑니다~
text_en: I always drink 2 cups.

text: 친구랑 방문했는데, 우드톤으로 분위기 너무이쁘고 다행히 웨이팅없이 입장했습니다,,🩷 테린느 워낙좋아하는데 메뉴에 있어서 넘좋았고 커피종류도 취향저격입니당,,🥺 사장님도 친절하시고 재방문의사100!
text_en: I visited with a friend, and the wood-toned atmosphere was so pretty and luckily we got in without waiting. I really like terrine, so it was great on the menu, and the types of coffee were perfect for my taste,,🥺 The owner is also kind and I would definitely visit again!

text: 자세한 내용은 제 블로그 <힐링 인 서울 포레스트>에 있어요.
text_en: More details can be found on my blog <Healing in Seoul Forest>.

text: 매장에서 마셔볼 수가 없어서 아쉬웠지만 직원분들도 친절하셨고 인테리어나 분위기도 좋아서 다음에 재방문하고 싶어요
text_en: It was a shame that I couldn't try the drink at the store, but the staff was friendly and the interior and atmosphere were nice, so I would like to visit again next time.

text: 딥초코+스팀우유 조합은 먼저 딥초코에 디저트 콕 찍어서 먹고 나중에 스팀우유 부어서 핫초코로 먹으면 극락입니다
text_en: The deep chocolate + steam milk combination is perfect if you first dip the dessert in deep chocolate and then pour steam milk over it and eat it as hot chocolate.

text: 소금빵 4개 12,000원 한세트고, 키오스크 주문하러가면 직원분이 '몇 세트 하실거예요'하고 물어보고 터치까지 직접 해주셔서 결제만 하면 돼요.
text_en: A set of 4 salt breads costs 12,000 won, and when you go to the kiosk to order, the staff will ask you 'how many sets you want to order' and even touch the bar so you can just pay.

text: 조용한 분위기에 주변이 내려다 보이는 구조의 매장이라 마음에 들었습니다.
text_en: I liked it because it was a store with a quiet atmosphere and a view of the surrounding area.

text: 오전 9시, 오후 12시 반, 오후 2시, 오후 3시 반, 오후 5시, 오후 6시 반.
단일메뉴 포장만 되는 곳 인데요 11시 살짝 넘어서 도착했는데 10분정도 기다린후 받았네요
text_en: It's a place that only offers single menu takeout. I arrived a little after 11 o'clock and waited about 10 minutes before receiving it.

text: 🫢 정구기 생카가서 쓸라고 아껴뒀는데 럭드랑 굿즈로 거의 다 쓴 아 근데 너무너무 귀여워서 만족스러움
text_en: 🫢 I was saving Jeong Gu-gi to use it when I buy it, but I used up almost all of it with luck and goodies. But it's so cute that I'm satisfied.

text: 그 때 처음 커마카세라는 걸 알게 되었는데 퍼모먼스도 재밌고 커피도 맛있어서 시즌마다 예약하고 가는 정도가 되었다.
text_en: That's when I first learned about Comakase. The performance was fun and the coffee was delicious, so I ended up making a reservation every season.

text: 나름 공간도 시원시원하고 커피도 종류가 많고 맛있습니다!
text_en: The space is cool and the coffee has a lot of variety and is delicious!

text: 카페크레마 엄청 부드럽고 콘파냐도 휘핑이 진짜 신기해요.
text_en: The cafe crema is very soft and the whipping of the con panna is really amazing.

text: 기안도를 구경하러 간김에 가 본 카페인데 너무나도 마음에들어 힐링하고 왔습니다.
text_en: I went to this cafe while I was visiting Giando Island, and I really liked it so much that I felt healed.

text: 시멘트와 크롬, 투명 플라스틱, 유리 등으로 굉장히 모던하고 미래적인😆인테리어가 인상적이고 커피도 맛있어용~
text_en: The interior is very modern and futuristic with cement, chrome, transparent plastic, and glass. The interior is impressive and the coffee is delicious.

text: 커피가 맛있어서 다음에도 제과제빵과 함께 하는 이벤트 또 했으면 좋겠어요!
text_en: The coffee is delicious, so I hope to have another event with baking next time!

text: 너나경보다가 승현이랑 대일이 소개팅 장소길래 찾아서 바로 방문했는데 직원분들 친절하시고 카페 내부 이쁘고 넓음!
text_en: While watching you, Seunghyun and Daeil saw this as a blind date spot, so I looked for it and immediately went there. The staff was friendly and the cafe interior was pretty and spacious!

text: 제가 주문란 메뉴는 호지차 / 잭살차 / 쑥티라미수 사실 디저트는 큰 기대 안 했는데 쑥티라미수가 정말 맛있더라구요
text_en: The menu items I ordered were Hojicha, Jacksal Tea, and Mugwort Tiramisu. Actually, I didn't expect much from dessert, but the Mugwort Tiramisu was really delicious.

text: 갓 나왔을 때 먹을때는 쥬시한 버터가 입안을 강타하고 폭신폭신 향긋했고, 식은 다음 먹으니 쫄깃하면서도 보통의 소금보다 덜 짜서 맛있게 잘 먹었습니다~
text_en: When I ate it when it came out, the juicy butter hit my mouth and it was fluffy and fragrant. When I ate it after it cooled down, it was chewy and less salty than regular salt, so it was delicious.

text: 일하는 분에 따라 커피 맛이 달라지는게 아쉽지만 그래도 굿
text_en: It's a shame that the taste of coffee varies depending on the person working, but it's still good.

text: 스콘 먹으러 또 가려고요!!
text_en: I’m going to go eat scones again!!

text: 본점에서 맛있게 먹었던 기억이 있어서 길 지나가다 오랫만에 소금빵 보여서 포장해서 지금 집에서 먹고 있는데 너무 짜서 못먹을 정도에요.
text_en: I remember eating delicious food at the main store, so I was passing by and saw salt bread for the first time in a while, so I packed it up and am eating it at home, but it's so salty that I can't eat it.

text: 👍 스콘이랑 소금번도 단백하니 맛있고 셈라를 처음 먹어봤는데 바삭한 그래롤라랑 먹는데 신기하고 맛있었어요
text_en: 👍 The scones and salt buns were simple and delicious. It was my first time eating semla, and eating it with crunchy granola was amazing and delicious.

text: 자연도 맛있어서 종종 사먹는데, 많은 사람들이 줄 서는 만큼 결제 순서 제대로 확인하고 소금빵 주셔야할거 같네요.
text_en: Natural food is delicious, so I often buy it, but since there are a lot of people waiting in line, I think I need to check the order of payment properly and give them salt bread.

text: 망고가 너무달고 맛있었고 크림과 케이크시트도 최고여서 친구들도 너무 맛있다고 여기 어디냐고 물어볼 정도였어요.
text_en: The mango was so sweet and delicious, and the cream and cake sheet were the best, so much so that my friends even asked where it was because it was so delicious.

text: 공간이 집을 개조해서 방마다 테이블이 한두개밖에 없다.
text_en: The space is a converted house, so there are only one or two tables in each room.

text: 분위기좋고 친절하시고 커피도맛있어요!
text_en: The atmosphere is nice and friendly, and the coffee is delicious!

text: 고소한 소금빵 근처가면 꼭 사옴~ 먹어본 소금빵 중 최고
text_en: I always buy savory salt bread whenever I go nearby. It's the best salt bread I've ever tasted.

text: 소금빵 4개 1세트로 빵 나올때 바로 시켜서 따뜻할때 먹으니 순삭이네용
text_en: It's a set of 4 salt breads, so you order it right when the bread comes out and eat it while it's warm, so it's a breeze.

text: 밥 먹고 후식 이요.
text_en: After eating, have dessert.

text: 날이 추워서 하동쑥차를 주문했는 데 고소하고 진한 쑥향이 너무 좋네요.
text_en: It was a cold day, so I ordered Hadong mugwort tea, and I really liked the rich, nutty mugwort scent.

text: 느끼한 걸 좋아하는 사람은 좋아할테지만 담백한 소금빵 파는 좀 호불호 갈리겠네요.
text_en: People who like greasy food will like it, but people who like the light salt bread may be a little divided.

text: 가만 보니 티비에서 봤던 성수동 그 소금빵집 엄청 크고 바삭했는데 많이 버터리하긴 하네요.
text_en: I looked at the salt bakery in Seongsu-dong that I saw on TV. It was big and crispy, but it was also very buttery.

text: 친절하고 빵이 진짜 맛있어용
text_en: They are friendly and the bread is really delicious.

text: 분위기 좋고 넓습니다!
text_en: Nice atmosphere and spacious!

text: 나무 탁자와 의자, 커피, 프렌치토스트 그 모든게 완벽했습니다.
text_en: The wooden table and chairs, coffee, and French toast were all perfect.

text: 👍🏻 꼭 먹어야 할정도는 아닌것 같구 근처에 있으면 들랴볼 만 한 곳!
text_en: 👍🏻 I don’t think it’s something you absolutely have to eat, but it’s a place worth stopping by if you’re nearby!

text: 커피 시그니처 시켰는데 너무 맛있고 이제 날씨도 따뜻해지는데 야외좌석에서 도란도란 얘기하기도 좋아요!!
text_en: I ordered the signature coffee, and it was delicious. Now that the weather is getting warmer, it's nice to sit outside and chat about it!!

text: 테이크아웃해서 마셔보고 싶었는데 오늘 날씨가 안 좋아서 포장으로만 구매했어요!
text_en: I wanted to take out and drink it, but the weather was bad today, so I only bought takeout!

text: 개인적으로 조금 더 빠쟉하고 버터동굴 깊은 소금빵을 좋아해서 완벽한 취저는 아니지만 충분히 호불호 안갈릴 맛있는 맛이였어요.
text_en: Personally, I like salt bread that is a little thicker and has a deep butter cave, so it's not a perfect meal, but it was delicious enough that you won't like it.

text: 와,, 낮에 날씨도 좋아서 햇빛 들어오고 카페 공간도 넓고 원래 가려던 카페 포기하고 들어와버렸습니다
text_en: Wow, the weather was nice during the day, so the sun came in and the cafe space was spacious, so I gave up on going to the cafe I was originally going to and went in.

text: 에스프레소 마시러 한번씩 가는곳~ 성수에 이렇게 좌석 편한곳 드물어서 좋아요~
text_en: This is a place I go to once in a while for an espresso. It's rare to find such comfortable seats in Seongsu, so I like it.

text: 이미 카페 한군데 더 갔다온 상태였는데도 동생이랑 정말 맛있게 클리어!
text_en: Even though I had already been to one more cafe, I had a really good time with my younger brother!

text: 오픈한지 얼마 안돼서 복잡스럽지 않게 사진 찍을 수 있었어용
text_en: Since it had just opened, I was able to take pictures without any hassle.

text: 빵구워 나오는 시간을 알려주시던데 빵이 가장 맛있는 갓구운 상태의 빵이 나오는 시간대에 줄 안서고 살 수 있다면 정말 좋을 것 같다는 생각이 드는 맛있는 빵집입니다.
text_en: It is a delicious bakery that tells you the time when the bread is baked, and I think it would be great if you could buy it without waiting in line during the time when the freshly baked bread is the most delicious.

text: 소금빵 너무너무 좋아해서 바로 구입했는데 제 입맛에는 먹어 본 소금빵 중에 젤 맛있게 먹었어요~
text_en: I liked salt bread so much that I bought it right away, and to my taste, it was the most delicious salt bread I've ever had.

text: 주말 저녁6시 30분 빵을 저녁 8시에 받았는데, 빵이 식어서 씹을때 기름이…엄청 느끼함…다음엔 따뜻한 빵을 먹어보고싶어요
text_en: I received the bread at 8pm at 6:30pm on the weekend, but the bread was cold and there was grease when I chewed it... I feel so... Next time, I want to try warm bread.

text: 뜨이는 다크하고 스트롱한 플랫화이트도 너무 맛있고 특히 사장님이 아침마다 직접만드신다는 버터바 땜에 일부러 찾아갑니다.
text_en: The dark and strong flat white is so delicious, and I especially go here because of the butter bar that the owner makes himself every morning.

text: 소금빵 전문점으로 소금빵 결제 대기줄에서 웨이팅 한 다음에 순서 차례가 되면 결제 후 구매한 수량만큼 빵 바로 받을 수 있어요!
text_en: This is a salt bread specialty store, so you can wait in the salt bread payment line and then when it's your turn, you can immediately receive the amount of bread you purchased after paying!

text: 딸기 크루아상은 겹겹이 파스라지는 식감 굿😚 오렌지 버터 스콘은 짭짤한 버터 맛이 강하고 오렌지 마멀레이드는 향보다는 버터를 잡아주는 정도
text_en: The strawberry croissant has a good crumbly texture in layers😚 The orange butter scone has a strong salty butter taste, and the orange marmalade has more of a buttery effect rather than a flavor.

text: 케익이 맛있고 직원분들이 친절해요
text_en: The cakes are delicious and the staff are friendly.

text: 카페도 예쁘고~!~
text_en: The cafe is pretty too~!~

text: 줄이길어도 여긴 테이크아웃 밖에안되고 단일메뉴라 대기줄 금방 줄어드니 겁먹지말고?!
text_en: Even if the line is long, this place only offers takeout and has a single menu, so don't be scared as the line will get shorter quickly!

text: 하며 기다렸다가 자리를 잡아 주문을 했는데 주문한 음료를 툭 치면서 애매하게 놓고 가는 가게는 처음 봤습니다..
text_en: I waited, took a seat, and placed my order, but this is the first time I've seen a store where people vaguely leave behind the drinks they ordered.

text: 메뉴에는 없어도 라떼도 주문 가능합니다.
text_en: Even though it is not on the menu, you can also order a latte.

text: 글고 버터맛이 강해서 더 맛있어요!
text_en: It tastes even better because it has a strong buttery taste!

text: 에스프레소가 깔끔하고 커피향이 좋아요!
text_en: The espresso is clean and the coffee smells great!

text: 함께 시킨 쑥티라미수는 쑥향이 생각보다는 약하지만 적절히 달아서 괜찮았음.
text_en: The mugwort tiramisu I ordered had a weaker mugwort flavor than I expected, but it was sweet enough to be okay.

text: 테이크아웃 전문점이지만 대기하는 테이크아웃 전문점입니다
text_en: Although it is a takeout restaurant, it is a takeout restaurant with a waiting area.

text: 키오스크로 주문하고 대기줄에서 기다렸다가 받았는데 단일품목이라 그런지 줄이 빨리 빠져서 10분 내외로 금방 받았어요.
text_en: I ordered at the kiosk and waited in line to receive it. Perhaps because it was a single item, the line moved quickly, so I received it in about 10 minutes.

text: 강남구청점만 가봤다가 성수동 와봤는데 매장도 넓고 테이블도 많고 좋아요.
text_en: I've only been to the Gangnam-gu Office branch and then to Seongsu-dong. The store is spacious and has many tables, which is nice.

text: 조용해서 작업하기 좋을 듯 해요
text_en: It's quiet so it's good for working.

text: 다음날먹어도 눅눅하지않고 바삭함이 다른곳에서 먹어본거랑 달라요!!
text_en: Even if you eat it the next day, it's not soggy and the crunchiness is different from what I've tried elsewhere!!

text: 다리가 아파서 잠시 쉬어가는데 아주 편하네요
text_en: My legs hurt so I took a break for a while and it was very comfortable.

text: 손님한텐 마스크쓰라면서 정작 여기 키큰 바리스타는 턱스크?
text_en: They tell customers to wear masks, but is the tall barista here actually a tusk?

text: 아직 딱딱할 수 있어서 1시간 후에 섭취하라하셨고 집와서 두시간정도 있다 먹었는데 크림이 진짜 너무 맛없는거에요..
text_en: They told me to eat it after an hour because it might still be hard. I ate it about two hours after I got home, but the cream was really tasteless.

text: 📸 아직 가오픈 중인데, 분위기부터 완벽해요.
text_en: 📸 It’s still in the process of opening, but the atmosphere is perfect.

text: 주말에는 줄 서는 곳인데 사람이 없어서 한 번 먹어보자하고 갔는데 낱개구매가 아니라 한봉지(4개입)로 팔더라고요.
text_en: There is a line on the weekends, but there was no one there, so I decided to give it a try, but instead of buying them individually, they were sold in bags (pack of 4).

text: 라떼랑 플랫화이트 마셨는데 라떼류를 잘하시는것 같아요!
text_en: I had a latte and a flat white, and I think you're good at lattes!

text: 매장도 조용해서 대화하기 좋아요!
text_en: The store is also quiet so it’s great for conversation!

text: 시음으로 맛있는게 확정된 오리지날 믹스만 구입 메뉴로써 맛이 있고 없고를 떠나 휘핑으로 인해 믹스의 맛을 느낄 수 없다면 실패가 아닌가 한다
text_en: Purchase only the original mix that has been confirmed to be delicious through tasting. Regardless of whether it is tasty or not, if you cannot taste the mix due to whipping, it is a failure.

text: 특별한 이벤트가 있다고 해서 방문했는데 커피 빵 너무 맛있고 직원분들 다 친절하시고 넓고 깨끗한 공간에 자주 와야겠어요
text_en: I visited because I heard there was a special event, and the coffee bread was so delicious and all the staff were friendly and the spacious and clean space made me want to come often.

text: 줄이 너무길어서 사봤는데 낱개로 팔지않아서 당황햇고..
text_en: The line was so long that I bought it, but I was confused because they didn't sell it individually.

text: 특히 커피 오마카세 경험해보고 싶어요.
text_en: I especially want to experience coffee omakase.

text: 일단 번화가임에도 불구하고 저렴한 가격대비 훌륭한 커피맛이네요!
text_en: First of all, even though it is in a busy area, the coffee tastes great for the low price!

text: 요즘 예약 안하면 케이크 사기 엄청 힘든데!!
text_en: These days, it’s very difficult to buy a cake if you don’t make a reservation!!

text: 장소도 쾌적하고 디저트도 맛있고 음료도 맛있었어요 !!
text_en: The place was comfortable, the desserts and drinks were delicious!!

text: 사람 많지 않은 시간대를 찾아서 애매한 오후에 갔는데 손님들 3~4팀 있었는데도 혼자서 시간 보내기 조용하고 너무 좋았어요.
text_en: I went on an odd afternoon to find a time when there weren't many people, and even though there were 3-4 groups of customers, it was quiet and nice to spend time alone.

text: 여자 알바생 융통성도 없고 겁나 띠꺼움 보니까 체인인 까페인데 정책이 그런건지 알바 교육이 잘못된 건지 모르겠지만 똑바로 영업하시길
text_en: Female part-time workers are inflexible and scary. It's a chain cafe. I don't know if it's the policy or the part-time training is wrong, but I hope you do business properly.

text: 4개 묶음으로만 판매해요 기름기 많다고 하는데 그래서 밑부분이 바삭하고 맛있어요!
text_en: They only sell it in packs of 4. They say it's very greasy, so the bottom is crispy and delicious!

text: 💕 한교동 잠옷 인형이 없어서 아쉬웠지만 그래도 다른 귀여운 인형으로 잘 입양해갑니당
text_en: 💕 It was a shame that I didn't have a Hangyo-dong pajama doll, but I decided to adopt another cute doll.

text: 맛있고 특별한 프렌치토스트를 맛볼 수 있다고 해서 찾아온 성수 브런치 카페 헨리스플랏인데요, 스콘도 정말 맛있어서 추천 드리고 싶어요.
text_en: I came to Henry's Plat, a brunch cafe in Seongsu, because I heard that you can taste delicious and special French toast. The scones are also really delicious, so I'd like to recommend it.

text: 다만 포장 전문점이니 포장직원을 한명 늘리던지 해서 빨리빨리 포장해 주셨으면 좋겠어요!
text_en: However, since this is a packaging specialty store, I hope they increase the number of packaging staff by one so that packaging can be done quickly!

text: 밖에 너무 더워서 대피했는데 음악도 좋고 조명도 예뻐여
text_en: It was so hot outside that I evacuated, but the music was good and the lighting was pretty.

text: 멋진 분위기에 맛있는 커피 그리고 잘 페어링 되는 디저트까지 너무 좋은 곳이었습니다!!
text_en: It was a great place with a great atmosphere, delicious coffee, and well-paired desserts!!

text: 다음에 재방문 하겠습니당
text_en: I will visit again next time

text: 생각보다 많이 안 기다렸구요 에프에 살짝 돌려 먹으면 극락 갑니다
text_en: I didn't have to wait as long as I thought. Just give it a little twist and you'll be in paradise.

text: 직원분들도 친절하시고 다른 디저트나 음료 다
text_en: The staff is friendly and they offer other desserts and drinks.

text: 리치팝 피치에이드랑 구테 넛 슈페너 주문했습니다!
text_en: I ordered Rich Pop Peachade and Goutte Nut Spener!

text: 성수동 오기 전에 연남동에서 길거리 걷다가 연남점 거 먹어보고 너무 맛있어서 지금까지 먹었었던 소금빵들이 스쳐 지나가면서 소금빵이 이런 거구나라고 생각하면서 감탄한 적이 있었어요
text_en: Before coming to Seongsu-dong, I was walking down the street in Yeonnam-dong and tried the Yeonnam branch and it was so delicious that I was impressed as I passed by the salt breads I had eaten so far and thought this is what salt bread is like.

text: 저희는 아이스아메리카노랑 애플망고빙수를 시켰는데 시즌별로 바뀐다고 하더라구요
text_en: We ordered iced Americano and apple mango shaved ice, and they said it changes depending on the season.

text: 커피는 산미가 조금 강해서 제 취향은 아니었지만 같이 주문한 로투스 케이크가 너무너무 맛있고 좋았습니다
text_en: The coffee was a little too acidic, so it wasn't my taste, but the lotus cake I ordered was very delicious and good.

text: 👍 직원분들도 친절하시거 무엇보다 소금빵이 찐으로 맛있어요…🙏 한번 구매해서 길가면서 먹다가 한번더 구매했어요
text_en: 👍 The staff are friendly and most of all, the salt bread is delicious when steamed… 🙏 I bought it once, ate it on the way, and then bought it again.

text: 제가 좋아하는 소금빵 맛집이에요
text_en: This is my favorite salt bread restaurant.

text: 놀이터 앞에 카페라 저녁에도 좋아요, 걸어걸어 오다보니 이런 곳이 있다니 크로플이랑 진한 커피맛이랑 너무 잘 어울려요.
text_en: It's a cafe in front of the playground, so it's great for evenings. As I walked, I came across a place like this, and it goes so well with Crople and the strong coffee flavor.

text: 🥰 재방문 의사 있습니다
text_en: 🥰 I intend to visit again

text: 죵말 예쁘고요🫶🏻 커피랑 베이커리도 생각보다 저렴해서 놀랐어요 성수동에 이런 규모와 인테리어에 가성비까지..?
text_en: It's really pretty🫶🏻 I was surprised that the coffee and bakery were cheaper than I expected. In Seongsu-dong, this size, interior, and cost-effectiveness..?

text: 첫 성수동 나들이 젤 좋아보이는 카페들어왔는데 넘 맛있고 예뻐요
text_en: On my first outing to Seongsu-dong, I came across the cafe that looked the best. It was so delicious and pretty.

text: 퇴근하고 성수가서 애들만나서 좀 놀다가 집갈때쯤 소금빵집에가서 소금뺭을 샀는데 웨이팅 1도 없어서 이게 웬일이야 하면서 냅다 구매해버렸숩니다 ~~
text_en: After work, I went to Seongsu and met the kids and had some fun. On my way home, I went to a salt bakery and bought salt bread, but there was no wait, so I thought what was going on and bought it.

text: 너무 맛있고 감성도 좋아요.
text_en: It's so delicious and has good sensibility.

text: 사람들 줄서있어서 한 번 사봤는데.
text_en: I bought it once because there were people waiting in line.

text: pxg 팝업 기다리면서 근처라 우연히들렀는데 메뉴 좋고 매장 깨끗하고 시원하고 좋네요
text_en: While waiting for the pxg pop-up, I happened to stop by because it was nearby. The menu was good and the store was clean, cool, and nice.

text: 디저트도 둘 다 맛있었어요
text_en: Both desserts were delicious.

text: 원래 성수에 가면 항상 카페가 고민이었어요;; 이번에 처음 방문해봤는데,, 좌석도 많고 매장도 넓고 무엇보다도 다양한 커피가 있어서 선택지가 많아 넘,, 좋았어요!!
text_en: Originally, when I went to Seongsu, I was always worried about cafes;; This was my first time visiting, and it was great because there were lots of seats, the store was spacious, and most of all, there were a variety of coffees to choose from!!

text: 가게 안에서는 먹을 곳이 없지만, 나와서 살짝 왼쪽으로 돌면 바닥에 플라스틱 박스 깔아놓은 곳에서 다들 앉아서 먹음.
text_en: There is no place to eat inside the store, but when you come out and turn slightly to the left, everyone sits and eats at a place where plastic boxes are laid out on the floor.

text: 제 최애 디저트집이에용
text_en: This is my favorite dessert place.

text: 하핫 손님이 한 테이블있어서 정말 조용해서 좋았어요.
text_en: Haha, it was nice that there was only one table with a customer so it was really quiet.

text: 사람이 많아서 정신 없었지만 생각보다 포토부스들도 너무 잘되어있었고 축전이 너무 귀여웠어요
text_en: It was crazy because there were so many people, but the photo booth was better than I expected and the congratulatory message was really cute.

text: 지난번 주말 낮에 왔을 땐 사람이 너무 많았는데, 저녁 때오니까 또 다른 느낌입니다.
text_en: Last weekend, when I came during the day, there were too many people, but it felt different when I came in the evening.

text: 성수 근처에서 에스프레소 마시고 싶을 때 들리기 좋아요!!
text_en: Great place to stop by when you want to drink espresso near Seongsu!!

text: 무조건 그 자리에서 바로 드세요
text_en: Always eat it right away.

text: 친구랑 여행계획 짜려고 카페 찾다가 우연히 들어갔는데 음악도 취향저격..
text_en: While looking for a cafe to plan a trip with a friend, I happened to go in and the music was also to my taste.

text: 소금빵 진짜 개애애애애애맛있다.
text_en: Salt bread is really delicious.

text: 인당 12,000원이면 파스타보다 저렴하니 1세트씩 드세요:)
text_en: At 12,000 won per person, it's cheaper than pasta, so eat one set each :)

text: 차는 역시나 맛있..
text_en: The tea is delicious as expected..

text: 키위케이크랑 말차쿠키도 맛나요♡
